Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo

Sub PrintForm()
	Call PrintLabel()
End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()
	par1=SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME

	'Set d7LB = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.ETIKET","GetEtiketTable", par1)
		Set d7LB  = Doc.Select1("_D7KIDSLB1", "D7KIDSLB", "KOD="&D7KIDSLB.KOD, "", -1)

	if d7LB.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 150

	Ustmargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 98
	EtiketEni = 150
	EtiketlerArasi = 0
	solMargin = 3
	sagMargin = EtiketEni - 2

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Etiket", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
'	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
'	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	For i = 1 to d7LB.GetRecCount()
		if i > 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
		Call Etiket(d7LB, pe1,i)
	Next 

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Etiket(d7LB, pe1,satirNo)
	StokKodu = d7LB.SKOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	LotNo = d7LB.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	SeriNo = d7LB.SERINO(satirNo)
	Miktar = d7LB.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	Birim = d7LB.SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	BarkodNo = d7LB.KOD(satirNo)
	Tarih = d7LB.REFTARIH1(satirNo)
	Tedarikci = d7LB.CH_TEDARIKCI(satirNo)
	Musteri = d7LB.CH_MUSTERI(satirNo)

	TedarikciAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Tedarikci, "")
	MusteriAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Musteri, "")

	AnaKod = Doc.Kod_SeviyeAl(StokKodu, -1)

	ChStokKodu = doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,Musteri)


	Ust = Ustmargin
	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
	
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust, solMargin, 10, 10, logo, 114)

	Aralik = 5
	Basla = Ust + 10
	Genislik1 = 5
	Genislik2 = 46
	Genislik3 = 93

	res= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res= pe1.box(ust,Solmargin,2*Aralik , sagMArgin-SolMargin)
	res= pe1.box(ust+2*Aralik,Solmargin, 3*Aralik ,sagMargin-SolMargin )
	res= pe1.box(ust+5*Aralik,Solmargin,2*Aralik, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res= pe1.box(ust+7*Aralik,Solmargin,5*Aralik, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res= pe1.box(ust+12*Aralik,Solmargin,3*Aralik, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res= pe1.box(ust+15*Aralik,Solmargin,3*Aralik, sagMargin-SolMargin)

	res= pe1.Line(ust+15*Aralik,Solmargin+Genislik2,3*Aralik, 0)
	res= pe1.Line(ust+2*Aralik,Solmargin+2*Genislik2,16*Aralik, 0)

	res= pe1.Line(ust,sagMargin,EtiketBoyu-Basla , 0)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Ust+Aralik-4, solMargin +Genislik1+5  , 10, sagMargin-solMargin - Genislik1-5, "ÜRETÝCÝ FÝRMA: ")
	res = pe1.Write(Ust+1*Aralik, solMargin +Genislik1+5, 10, sagMargin-solMargin - Genislik1-5, "CAVO OTOMOTÝV SAN. TÝC. A.Þ.")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)

Public ustmargin, solmargin, sagMargin, satirYuksekligi, sirano
Dim sayfaSatirsayisi, AraToplam, Grid, satirSonu, satirBaslangic

Sub PrintForm()
		
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")

	satirYuksekligi = 4.3

	Redim xCizgi(0)

	Ustmargin = 2 * satirYuksekligi
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 17 * satirYuksekligi

	solmargin = 6
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	satirpozr = 0

	sayfaSatirsayisi = 30
	sirano = 0
	sayfaSatirPozr = UstMargin + 9 * satirYuksekligi
	CKSN22T.SafePack

	satirSayisi = CKSN22T.GetRecCount
	Call Alanlar()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63
	SatirSonu = 260
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 63
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "CAVO OTOMOTÝV SAN.TÝC.A.Þ.")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 6, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "Ç E K   Ç I K I Þ   B O R D R O S U")


	'logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGOC1"))

	logo  = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))

 	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.NoPen()

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

 IF TRIM(VergiNo) <> "" THEN

 ELSE

 END IF

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(CKSN22T.E_CKSNNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i, 0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "_BANKASUBE" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN22T.E_BANKA(satirNo))
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SEHIR" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN22T.E_SUBE(satirNo))
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_CEKHESAPNO" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN22T.E_OREVRAKNO(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN22T.E_HESAPNO(satirNo))
		else
			Degisken = CKSN22T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi, SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		if degiskenAdi = "E_OR_TUTAR" then
			solTutar = sol
			GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_TL_TUTAR" then
			solTLTutar = sol
			GenTLTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_OR_KUR" then
			solPB = sol
			GenPB = SutunGenisligi
		end if
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i, 6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i, 4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	satirUst = satirBaslangic -  4 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))
	res = pe1.box(satirUst, SolMargin, satirSonu - satirUst, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - satirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If lineX = 0 Then Exit For
		if i <> 6 then
			res = pe1.Line(satirUst, LineX, satirSonu - satirUst, 0)
		end if
	Next

	sBAsla = satirSonu + satirYuksekligi
	res = pe1.line(sBAsla, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	ToplamTutar = CKSN22E.TL_TOPLAMTUTAR

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 30, ": "& CKSN22T.GetRecCount)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 8, 2, ":")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	ToplamBasla = pe1.GetTop
	Set ToplamTable = BordroToplamTable()
	if ToplamTable.GetRecCount = 1 Then
	 	res = pe1.Write(ToplamBasla, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTable.E_OR_TUTAR(1),20,Grid(6,6)))
	 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, ToplamTable.E_OR_KUR(1))
	Else
		ToplamBasla = ToplamBasla - satirYuksekligi
		for i = 1 to ToplamTable.GetRecCount
		 	res = pe1.Write(ToplamBasla + (i-1) * satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTable.E_OR_TUTAR(i),20,Grid(6,6)))
		 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, ToplamTable.E_OR_KUR(i))
		Next
	End if
 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solTLTutar, 5, GenTLTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTutar,20,Grid(8,6)))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	PB = Doc.DefaultPB
' 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, 20, Doc.DefaultPB)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN22E.ORTALAMARVALOR))

	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText_TL(ToplamTutar)
	if trim(PB) = trim(Doc.DefaultPB) then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "YALNIZ " & Yalniz & " hesabýnýza borç kaydedilmiþtir.")
	end if

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "YETKÝLÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 5, 52, "DÜZENLEYEN")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	alt = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 4 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "LÜTFEN FAKSLAYINIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solmargin + 139, 5, 52, "ÖDEMEYÝ EKSÝKSÝZ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALDIM")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "KAÞE - ÝMZA")

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	res = pe1.line(alt, solMargin + 1, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 0, 40)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8, 7)

	Grid(0, 0) = "E_CKSNNO"
	Grid(1, 0) = "E_KESIDECI"
	Grid(2, 0) = "_BANKASUBE"
	Grid(3, 0) = "_SEHIR"
	Grid(4, 0) = "_CEKHESAPNO"
	Grid(5, 0) = "E_RVADE"
	Grid(6, 0) = "E_OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(7, 0) = "E_OR_KUR"
	Grid(8, 0) = "E_TL_TUTAR"

	Grid(0, 1) = 12
	Grid(1, 1) = 37
	Grid(2, 1) = 27
	Grid(3, 1) = 35
	Grid(4, 1) = 24
	Grid(5, 1) = 17
	Grid(6, 1) = 18
	Grid(7, 1) = 8
	Grid(8, 1) = 18

	Grid(0, 2) = "ÇEK NO"
	Grid(1, 2) = "KEÞÝDECÝ"
	Grid(2, 2) = "BANKA / ÞUBE"
	Grid(3, 2) = "ÞEHÝR"
	Grid(4, 2) = "BANKA ÇEK / HESAP NO"
	Grid(5, 2) = "VADE TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(6, 2) = "TUTARI"
	Grid(7, 2) = ""
	Grid(8, 2) = "TL TUTAR"

	Grid(0, 4) = "C"
	Grid(1, 4) = "C"
	Grid(2, 4) = "C"
	Grid(3, 4) = "C"
	Grid(4, 4) = "C"
	Grid(5, 4) = "D"
	Grid(6, 4) = "N"
	Grid(7, 4) = "C"
	Grid(8, 4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i, 0)
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			ondalik = CKSN22T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i, 6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(6, 6) = 2
	Grid(8, 6) = 2
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	for i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr, solMargin + 136, 5, 20, "SAYFA")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	Next
End Sub
Function BordroToplamTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=CKSN22T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set C10T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set CK10T = Doc.GetTableObject("CKSN22T")
	C10T.CopyTable(CK10T)
	C10T.GroupBy2("E_OR_KUR")
	Set BordroToplamTable = C10T
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýnalma Sipariþi",297,210,"")

	satirbaslangic=131
	satirno=0
	eurotoplam=0
	totalamount=0
	tltoplam=0
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 
				satirno=satirno+1
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
		SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
		For i=1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		Baslik = Trim(CStr(i)) + " / " + Trim(CStr(pe1.GetPageCount()))	
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(27,172,4,50,"\b  \b0  " & Baslik & "") 	   
		Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	If satirno = 20 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=131 
	End If	

	satirpozr= satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5 
	
	stokkod=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	stokkodu = doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokKod,chkodu)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	if trim(stokkodu)= ""then
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,30,4,37,stokkod)
	else
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,30,4,37,stokkodu)
	end if
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	'stokadi=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","NAME2",stokkod,-1) 
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,45,4,77,stokadi)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	miktar=STOK46T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	birim=STOK46T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,65,4,20,miktar)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,95,4,8,birim)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	fiyat=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK46T.OR_FIYAT(i),15,4)
	isk= Doc.NumFormat0(STOK46T.ISKONTO_EFEKTIF(i),15,2)
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,125,4,19,fiyat)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,98,4,19,isk)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	testar=Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,170,4,23,testar)

End Sub                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             


----------------------------------------------------------------
Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : CAVO_2016 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : **FABHÝZ2
Hangi Tablo için : STOK70
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : STOK70I
Açýklama : HÝZMET SATIÞ FATURASI VADE+DÖVÝZ (2 DÝJÝT) 3320
Kod : 
Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satirYuksekligi, satirpozr, sirano, S70T, ST70, GenTutar, cPi
Dim sayfaSatirsayisi, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin, AraToplam, KalanLimit, SolTutar, IrsNolar, IrsTarihleri


Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	cPi = 17
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(cPi)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", 295, 240, "")

	satirYuksekligi = 4.3
	ustmargin = -3 * satirYuksekligi
	solmargin = 11
	altmargin = UstMargin + 142
	satirpozr = 0
	satirsolmargin = 10
	satirbaslangic = ustmargin + 25 * satirYuksekligi

	AraToplam = 0
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
	S70T.SafePack
	sayfaSatirsayisi = 25

	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70 = Doc.GetTableObject("YYY")
	Set SS70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70.CopyTable(SS70)

'	ST70.GroupBy("IRSALIYENO")
'	if trim(STOK70E.NITELIK) = "XF" then
'		rows = Doc.SelectEQ("UFLD10T", "EVRAKNO", Doc.LeftJustify("FT", 10))
'		KalanLimit = Rows + 4
'	else
		KalanLimit = 1
'	end if
'	msgbox KalanLimit

	satirSayisi = S70T.GetRecCount()
	sirano = 0
	
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)	
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub


'//// SAYFA BAÞI BÝLGÝLERÝ PROSEDÜRÜ////
Sub sayfabasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial" , 7)
	chKod = STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chAdi2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, "")
	chAdres1 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chAdres2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chAdres3 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	chVergiDairesi = Left(trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")),30)
	chVergiNo = trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, ""))
	if trim(chVergiNo) = "" Then chVergiNo = trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "TCNO", chkod, ""))
	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)	
	Evrakno = 	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	FaturaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))

	res=pe1.write(55, 35, 4, 100, chadi) 
	res=pe1.write(59, 35, 4, 150, chadres1)
	res=pe1.write(62, 35, 4, 150, chadres2)
	res=pe1.write(65, 35, 4, 150, chadres3)
	res=pe1.write(77, 35, 4, 80, chvergidairesi)
	res=pe1.write(77, 85, 4, 50, chvergino)
	res=pe1.write(62, 155,4, 30, Faturatarihi)
End Sub


'//// SATIR BÝLGÝLERÝ PROSEDÜRÜ /////
Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	sirano = sirano + 1
	satirsolmargin = solMargin + 2
	KalanSatirSayisi = S70T.GetRecCount() - i + 1 
	kalanKapasite = sayfaSatirsayisi - sirano
	
	if KalanSatirSayisi = 1 and kalanKapasite < KalanLimit then
		Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano = 1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	elseif KalanSatirSayisi < KalanLimit then
		if sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		end if
	else
		If sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 and KalanSatirSayisi > 1 Then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		End If
	end if
	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano - 1) * satirYuksekligi
	if pe1.GetPageCount() > 1 and sirano = 1 then 
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "NAKLÝ YEKÜN") 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, solTutar, satirYuksekligi, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		satirpozr = satirpozr + satirYuksekligi
		sirano = sirano + 1
	end if
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	stokkodu = S70T.KOD(i)
	aciklama=S70T.NOTES(i)
	ack=aciklama
	Stok = StokKodu
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	miktar = S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	stokbirim = TRIM(S70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i))
	tutar = S70T.TL_TUTAR(i)
	AraToplam = AraToplam + tutar
	Fiyat = S70T.TL_FIYAT(i)
	ondMiktar = Doc.SigDig(miktar)
	Miktar = Doc.NumFormat(Miktar, 15, 2)
	Fiyat = Doc.NumFormat(Fiyat, 20, 2)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar, 20, 2)
	GenTutar = 32
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 8, satirYuksekligi, 90, ack)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 25, satirYuksekligi, 93, stokadi)
' 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 115, satirYuksekligi, 8, miktar)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 125, satirYuksekligi, 8, stokbirim) 
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 134, satirYuksekligi, 13, fiyat) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 148, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, tutar) 
	SolTutar = pe1.GetLeft
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
End Sub

Sub AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "ARA TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, SolTutar, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)	

	vadetarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH)
	Toplam = doc.numformat0(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM, 30, 2)
	Nettoplam = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM
	kdvtoplam = STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM
	geneltoplam = nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	geneltoplam = Doc.numformat0(geneltoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat = STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1
	odenecekmiktar = STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM
	odenecekkdv = kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv = Doc.numformat0(odenecekkdv, 30, 2)
	odenecekmiktar = Doc.numformat0(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani = Doc.Div(kdvtoplam, Nettoplam) * 100
	KDVOndalik = Doc.SigDig(Doc.Round(kdvorani, 2))
	KDVOrani = Doc.NumFormat(kdvorani, 6, KDVOndalik)
	Nettoplam = Doc.numformat0(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtoplam = Doc.numformat0(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)

	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
	solAciklama = solTutar - 25

	res = pe1.Setalign("left")
	res = pe1.write(195, 114, 4, 30, "KDV'SÝZ TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(195, 145, 4,gentutar , Toplam) 
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(200,114, 4, 30, "KDV TOPLAMI: ")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(200, 145, 4, gentutar, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(205,114, 4, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM :")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(205, 145,4, gentutar, geneltoplam)

	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
	kurus=instr(1,doc.numtotext(geneltoplam),"%")
	if kurus=0 then
	tl=Doc.Numtotext(geneltoplam)& + "" & " TL"
	else
	tl=left(Doc.NumToText(geneltoplam),kurus-1)&+" "& +"TL"
	kr=right(Doc.NumtoText(geneltoplam),len(doc.numtotext(geneltoplam))-kurus) &+"  "&+"kr"
	tl=tl& +" "+ kr
	end if

	res=pe1.write(205,10, 10, 100, "YALNIZ:" & +" " +  tl)
	sonodeme=doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH)
	res=pe1.write(210,10,4,100,"SON ÖDEME:" & + "  " + sonodeme)

'	irsaliye_no = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
'	irsaliye_trh= doc.strtonordate(doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK60E", "TARIH", irsaliye_no, ""))
'	res=pe1.write(215, 10, 4,80, "ÝRSALÝYE NO VE TARÝH" & irsaliye_no  & "   " & irsaliye_trh )
	dovizkuru=doc.numformat0(STOK70T.KUR(1),12,4)
	res=pe1.write(215,10,10,95, "DÖVÝZ KURU:"&+"   "+dovizkuru) 

End Sub

		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano = 1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	elseif KalanSatirSayisi < KalanLimit then
		if sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		end if
	else
		If sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 and KalanSatirSayisi > 1 Then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		End If
	end if
	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano - 1) * satirYuksekligi
	if pe1.GetPageCount() > 1 and sirano = 1 then 
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "NAKLÝ YEKÜN") 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, solTutar, satirYuksekligi, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		satirpozr = satirpozr + satirYuksekligi
		sirano = sirano + 1
	end if
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	stokkodu = S70T.KOD(i)
	aciklama=S70T.NOTES(i)
	ack=aciklama
	Stok = StokKodu
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	miktar = S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'	stokbirim = S70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar = S70T.TL_TUTAR(i)
	AraToplam = AraToplam + tutar
	Fiyat = Doc.Div(tutar, miktar)
	ondMiktar = Doc.SigDig(miktar)
	Miktar = Doc.NumFormat0(Miktar, 15, 2)
	Fiyat = Doc.NumFormat0(Fiyat, 20, 4)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(Tutar, 20, 2)
	GenTutar = 32
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 8, satirYuksekligi, 45, ack)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 25, satirYuksekligi, 93, stokadi)
' 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 115, satirYuksekligi, 8, miktar)
'	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 125, satirYuksekligi, 8, stokbirim) 
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 134, satirYuksekligi, 10, fiyat) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 148, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, tutar) 
	SolTutar = pe1.GetLeft
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

End Sub

Sub AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "ARA TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, SolTutar, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)	

	vadetarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH)
	Toplam = doc.numformat(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM, 30, 2)
	Nettoplam = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM
	kdvtoplam = STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM
	geneltoplam = nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	geneltoplam = Doc.numformat(geneltoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat = STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1
	odenecekmiktar = STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM
	odenecekkdv = kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv = Doc.numformat(odenecekkdv, 30, 2)
	odenecekmiktar = Doc.numformat(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani = Doc.Div(kdvtoplam, Nettoplam) * 100
	KDVOndalik = Doc.SigDig(Doc.Round(kdvorani, 2))
	KDVOrani = Doc.NumFormat(kdvorani, 6, KDVOndalik)
	Nettoplam = Doc.numformat(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtoplam = Doc.numformat(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)

	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
	solAciklama = solTutar - 25

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(195, 124, 4, 33, "KDV'SÝZ TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(195, 148, 4,32 , Toplam) 
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(200,124, 4, 30, "KDV TOPLAMI: ")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(200, 148, 4, 32, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(205,124, 4, 30, "GENEL TOPLAM :")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(205, 148,4, 32, geneltoplam)

	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
	kurus=instr(1,doc.numtotext(geneltoplam),"%")
	if kurus=0 then
	tl=Doc.Numtotext(geneltoplam)& + "" & " TL"
	else
	tl=left(Doc.NumToText(geneltoplam),kurus-1)&+" "& +"TL"
	kr=right(Doc.NumtoText(geneltoplam),len(doc.numtotext(geneltoplam))-kurus) &+"  "&+"kr"
	tl=tl& +" "+ kr
	end if

	res=pe1.write(205,10, 10, 100, "YALNIZ:" & +" " +  tl)
	sonodeme=doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH)
	res=pe1.write(210,10,4,100,"SON ÖDEME:" & + "  " + sonodeme)

'	irsaliye_no = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
'	irsaliye_trh= doc.strtonordate(doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK60E", "TARIH", irsaliye_no, ""))
'	res=pe1.write(215, 10, 4,80, "ÝRSALÝYE NO VE TARÝH" & irsaliye_no  & "   " & irsaliye_trh )
	dovizkuru=doc.numformat0(STOK70T.KUR(1),12,4)
	res=pe1.write(215,10,10,95, "DÖVÝZ KURU:"&+"   "+dovizkuru) 

End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : CAVO_2016 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : **FABSAT4
Hangi Tablo için : STOK70
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : SATIÞ FATURASI FABRÝKA VADE+DÖVÝZ (2+3+4 DÝJÝT)
Kod : 
Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satirYuksekligi, satirpozr, sirano, S70T, ST70, GenTutar, cPi
Dim sayfaSatirsayisi, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin, AraToplam, KalanLimit, SolTutar, IrsNolar, IrsTarihleri


Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	cPi = 17
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(cPi)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", 295, 240, "")

	satirYuksekligi = 4.3
	ustmargin = -3 * satirYuksekligi
	solmargin = 11
	altmargin = UstMargin + 142
	satirpozr = 0
	satirsolmargin = 10
	satirbaslangic = ustmargin + 25 * satirYuksekligi

	AraToplam = 0
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
	S70T.SafePack
	S70T.GROUPBY("KOD+IRSALIYENO")
	sayfaSatirsayisi = 25

	Doc.CreateTableObject "YYY=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set ST70 = Doc.GetTableObject("YYY")
	Set SS70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	ST70.CopyTable(SS70)

'	ST70.GroupBy("IRSALIYENO")
'	if trim(STOK70E.NITELIK) = "XF" then
'		rows = Doc.SelectEQ("UFLD10T", "EVRAKNO", Doc.LeftJustify("FT", 10))
'		KalanLimit = Rows + 4
'	else
		KalanLimit = 1
'	end if
'	msgbox KalanLimit

	satirSayisi = S70T.GetRecCount()
	sirano = 0
	
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)	
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub


'//// SAYFA BAÞI BÝLGÝLERÝ PROSEDÜRÜ////
Sub sayfabasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial" , 7)
	chKod = STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chAdi2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, "")
	chAdres1 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chAdres2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chAdres3 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	chVergiDairesi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")
	chVergiNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	SiparisNo = STOK70T.SIPNO(1)	
	Evrakno = 	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	FaturaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))

	res=pe1.write(55, 35, 4, 100, chadi) 
	res=pe1.write(59, 35, 4, 150, chadres1)
	res=pe1.write(62, 35, 4, 150, chadres2)
	res=pe1.write(65, 35, 4, 150, chadres3)
	res=pe1.write(77, 35, 4, 80, chvergidairesi)
	res=pe1.write(77, 85, 4, 50, chvergino)
	res=pe1.write(46, 165,4, 30, Faturatarihi)
End Sub


'//// SATIR BÝLGÝLERÝ PROSEDÜRÜ /////
Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	sirano = sirano + 1
	satirsolmargin = solMargin + 2
	KalanSatirSayisi = S70T.GetRecCount() - i + 1 
	kalanKapasite = sayfaSatirsayisi - sirano
	
	if KalanSatirSayisi = 1 and kalanKapasite < KalanLimit then
		Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano = 1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	elseif KalanSatirSayisi < KalanLimit then
		if sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		end if
	else
		If sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 and KalanSatirSayisi > 1 Then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		End If
	end if
	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano - 1) * satirYuksekligi
	if pe1.GetPageCount() > 1 and sirano = 1 then 
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "NAKLÝ YEKÜN") 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, solTutar, satirYuksekligi, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 4)) 		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		satirpozr = satirpozr + satirYuksekligi
		sirano = sirano + 1
	end if
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	stokkodu = S70T.KOD(i)
	Stok = StokKodu
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	miktar = S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'	lot = S70T.LOTNUMBER(i)
	tutar = S70T.TL_TUTAR(i)
	AraToplam = AraToplam + tutar
	Fiyat = FiyatBul1(S70T.KOD(i))
	ondMiktar = Doc.SigDig(miktar)
	Miktar = Doc.NumFormat0(Miktar, 15, 2)
	ondF = Doc.SigDig(fiyat)
	if ondf =>4 and ondf > 3 then
		ondf=4
	elseif ondf=3 then
			ondf=3
	else
		ondf=2
	end if
	Fiyat = Doc.NumFormat0(Fiyat, 20, ondf)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(Tutar, 20, 2)

	GenTutar = 32
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 8, satirYuksekligi, 16, stok)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 25, satirYuksekligi, 79, trim(stokadi)&" "&Trim(LOT))
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 105, satirYuksekligi, 15, miktar)
	
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, satirYuksekligi, 13, fiyat) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 149, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, tutar) 
	SolTutar = pe1.GetLeft
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
End Sub

Sub AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "ARA TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, SolTutar, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

	dovizkuru=doc.numformat0(STOK70T.KUR(1),12,4)
	res=pe1.write(220,10,10,95, "DÖVÝZ KURU:"&+"   "+dovizkuru) 

End Sub
Function FiyatBul1(StokKodu)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		if STOK70T.KOD(i) = StokKodu then
			FiyatBul1 = STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i)
			Exit Function
		End if
	Next
End Function

			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		end if
	else

			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1

		End If
	end if

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "NAKLÝ YEKÜN") 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, solTutar, satirYuksekligi, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		satirpozr = satirpozr + satirYuksekligi
		sirano = sirano + 1
	end if
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	stokkodu = S70T.KOD(i)
	Stok = StokKodu
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	miktar = S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'	LOT = S70T.LOTNUMBER(i)
	tutar = S70T.TL_TUTAR(i)
	AraToplam = AraToplam + tutar
	Fiyat = FiyatBul1(S70T.KOD(i))
 'Fiyat = Doc.Div(tutar, miktar)
	ondMiktar = Doc.SigDig(miktar)
	OndC=S70T.MaxSigDig("TL_FIYAT")
	Miktar = Doc.NumFormat0(Miktar, 15, 2)
	Fiyat = Doc.NumFormat0(Fiyat, 20,ondc)
	Tutar = Doc.Numformat0(Tutar, 20, 2)
	ondF = Doc.SigDig(fiyat)
	GenTutar = 32
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 8, satirYuksekligi, 16, stok)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 25, satirYuksekligi, 59, stokadi)
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 108, satirYuksekligi, 13, miktar)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, satirYuksekligi, 13, LOT) 
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, satirYuksekligi, 13, fiyat) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 148, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, tutar) 
	SolTutar = pe1.GetLeft
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
End Sub

Sub AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "ARA TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, SolTutar, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 2)) 
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)	

	vadetarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH)
	Toplam = doc.numformat0(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM, 30, 2)
	Nettoplam = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM
	kdvtoplam = STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM
	geneltoplam = nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	geneltoplam = Doc.numformat0(geneltoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat = STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1
	odenecekmiktar = STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM
	odenecekkdv = kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv = Doc.numformat0(odenecekkdv, 30, 2)
	odenecekmiktar = Doc.numformat0(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
	kdvorani = Doc.Div(kdvtoplam, Nettoplam) * 100
	KDVOndalik = Doc.SigDig(Doc.Round(kdvorani, 2))
	KDVOrani = Doc.NumFormat(kdvorani, 6, KDVOndalik)
	Nettoplam = Doc.numformat0(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtoplam = Doc.numformat0(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)

	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
	solAciklama = solTutar - 25

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(195, 125, 4, 75, "KDV'SÝZ TOPLAM:") 
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(195, 148, 4,gentutar , Toplam) 
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(200,125, 4, 75, "KDV TOPLAMI: ")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(200, 148, 4, gentutar, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(205,125, 4, 75, "GENEL TOPLAM :")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(205, 148,4, gentutar, geneltoplam)

	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
	kurus=instr(1,doc.numtotext(geneltoplam),"%")
	if kurus=0 then
	tl=Doc.Numtotext(geneltoplam)& + "" & " TL"
	else
	tl=left(Doc.NumToText(geneltoplam),kurus-1)&+" "& +"TL"
	kr=right(Doc.NumtoText(geneltoplam),len(doc.numtotext(geneltoplam))-kurus) &+"  "&+"kr"
	tl=tl& +" "+ kr
	end if

	res=pe1.write(205,10, 10, 100, "YALNIZ:" & +" " +  TL)
	sonodeme=doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH)
	res=pe1.write(210,10,4,100,"SON ÖDEME:" & + "  " + sonodeme)

'	irsaliye_no = STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
'	irsaliye_trh= doc.strtonordate(doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK60E", "TARIH", irsaliye_no, ""))
'	res=pe1.write(215, 10, 4,80, "ÝRSALÝYE NO VE TARÝH" & irsaliye_no  & "   " & irsaliye_trh )
	dovizkuru=doc.numformat0(STOK70T.KUR(1),12,4)
	res=pe1.write(215,10,10,95, "DÖVÝZ KURU:"&+"   "+dovizkuru) 

End Sub
Function FiyatBul1(StokKodu)
	For i = 1 to STOK70T.GetRecCount()
		if STOK70T.KOD(i) = StokKodu then
			FiyatBul1 = STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i)
			Exit Function
		End if
	Next
End Function

Public ustmargin, solmargin, sagMargin, satirYuksekligi, sirano
Dim sayfaSatirsayisi, AraToplam, Grid, satirSonu, satirBaslangic
Dim solTutar, GenTutar, solPB, GenPB, xCizgi(), sayfaSatirPozr, solTLTutar, GenTLTutar
Sub PrintForm()
		
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")

	satirYuksekligi = 4.3

	Redim xCizgi(0)

	Ustmargin = 2 * satirYuksekligi
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 17 * satirYuksekligi

	solmargin = 6
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	satirpozr = 0

	sayfaSatirsayisi = 30
	sirano = 0
	sayfaSatirPozr = UstMargin + 9 * satirYuksekligi
	CKSN22T.SafePack

	satirSayisi = CKSN22T.GetRecCount
	Call Alanlar()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63
	SatirSonu = 260
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 63
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(Firma))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 6, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "Ç E K   Ç I K I Þ   B O R D R O S U")


	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGOM"))
 	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 8, SolMargin + 135, 150,65,logo, 114)






	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	CHKodu = CKSN22E.CIKISCODE
	Unvan1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", CHKodu, "")
	Unvan2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", CHKodu, "")
	Adres1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", CHKodu, "")
	Adres2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", CHKodu, "")
	Adres3 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", CHKodu, "")
	VergiDairesi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", CHKodu, "")
	VergiNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", CHKodu, "")

	BBasla = 30
	KutuEn = 100
	res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 1, 5, KutuEn, CHKodu)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Unvan1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Unvan2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, "Vergi Dairesi : " & VergiDairesi & " Vergi No : " & VergiNo)

	res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, solMargin, pe1.GetBottom - BBasla + 2, KutuEn + 2)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 136, 10, 20, "TARÝH")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN22E.TARIH))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 136, 10, 20, "BORDRO NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & trim(CKSN22E.EVRAKNO))

	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1)
		Baslik = Grid(i, 2)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 3 * satirYuksekligi, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(uBound(XCizgi)) = sol - 1
		Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(XCizgi) + 1)
	Next
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(CKSN22T.E_CKSNNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i, 0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "_BANKASUBE" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN22T.E_BANKA(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN22T.E_SUBE(satirNo))
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SEHIR" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",CKSN22T.E_SEHIR(satirNo),-1)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_CEKHESAPNO" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN22T.E_OREVRAKNO(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN22T.E_HESAPNO(satirNo))
		else
			Degisken = CKSN22T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi, SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		if degiskenAdi = "E_OR_TUTAR" then
			solTutar = sol
			GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_TL_TUTAR" then
			solTLTutar = sol
			GenTLTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_OR_KUR" then
			solPB = sol
			GenPB = SutunGenisligi
		end if
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i, 6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i, 4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	satirUst = satirBaslangic -  4 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))
	res = pe1.box(satirUst, SolMargin, satirSonu - satirUst, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - satirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If lineX = 0 Then Exit For
		if i <> 6 then
			res = pe1.Line(satirUst, LineX, satirSonu - satirUst, 0)
		end if
	Next

	sBAsla = satirSonu + satirYuksekligi
	res = pe1.line(sBAsla, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	ToplamTutar = CKSN22E.TL_TOPLAMTUTAR

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 30, ": "& CKSN22T.GetRecCount)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 8, 2, ":")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	ToplamBasla = pe1.GetTop
	Set ToplamTable = BordroToplamTable()
	if ToplamTable.GetRecCount = 1 Then
	 	res = pe1.Write(ToplamBasla, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTable.E_OR_TUTAR(1),20,Grid(6,6)))
	 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, ToplamTable.E_OR_KUR(1))
	Else
		ToplamBasla = ToplamBasla - satirYuksekligi
		for i = 1 to ToplamTable.GetRecCount
		 	res = pe1.Write(ToplamBasla + (i-1) * satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTable.E_OR_TUTAR(i),20,Grid(6,6)))
		 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, ToplamTable.E_OR_KUR(i))
		Next
	End if
 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solTLTutar, 5, GenTLTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTutar,20,Grid(8,6)))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	PB = Doc.DefaultPB
' 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, 20, Doc.DefaultPB)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN22E.ORTALAMARVALOR))

	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText_TL(ToplamTutar)
	if trim(PB) = trim(Doc.DefaultPB) then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "YALNIZ " & Yalniz & " hesabýnýza borç kaydedilmiþtir.")
	end if

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "YETKÝLÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 5, 52, "DÜZENLEYEN")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	alt = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 4 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "LÜTFEN FAKSLAYINIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solmargin + 139, 5, 52, "ÖDEMEYÝ EKSÝKSÝZ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALDIM")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "KAÞE - ÝMZA")

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	res = pe1.line(alt, solMargin + 1, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 0, 40)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8, 7)

	Grid(0, 0) = "E_CKSNNO"
	Grid(1, 0) = "E_KESIDECI"
	Grid(2, 0) = "_BANKASUBE"
	Grid(3, 0) = "_SEHIR"
	Grid(4, 0) = "_CEKHESAPNO"
	Grid(5, 0) = "E_RVADE"
	Grid(6, 0) = "E_OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(7, 0) = "E_OR_KUR"
	Grid(8, 0) = "E_TL_TUTAR"

	Grid(0, 1) = 12
	Grid(1, 1) = 37
	Grid(2, 1) = 34
	Grid(3, 1) = 19
	Grid(4, 1) = 24
	Grid(5, 1) = 17
	Grid(6, 1) = 26
	Grid(7, 1) = 8
	Grid(8, 1) = 20

	Grid(0, 2) = "ÇEK NO"
	Grid(1, 2) = "KEÞÝDECÝ"
	Grid(2, 2) = "BANKA / ÞUBE"
	Grid(3, 2) = "ÞEHÝR"
	Grid(4, 2) = "BANKA ÇEK / HESAP NO"
	Grid(5, 2) = "VADE TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(6, 2) = "TUTARI"
	Grid(7, 2) = ""
	Grid(8, 2) = "TL TUTAR"

	Grid(0, 4) = "C"
	Grid(1, 4) = "C"
	Grid(2, 4) = "C"
	Grid(3, 4) = "C"
	Grid(4, 4) = "C"
	Grid(5, 4) = "D"
	Grid(6, 4) = "N"
	Grid(7, 4) = "C"
	Grid(8, 4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i, 0)
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			ondalik = CKSN22T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i, 6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(6, 6) = 2
	Grid(8, 6) = 2
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	for i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr, solMargin + 136, 5, 20, "SAYFA")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	Next
End Sub
Function BordroToplamTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=CKSN22T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set C10T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set CK10T = Doc.GetTableObject("CKSN22T")
	C10T.CopyTable(CK10T)
	C10T.GroupBy2("E_OR_KUR")
	Set BordroToplamTable = C10T
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 12
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				if degiskenadi="MKOD" then
					degisken=	doc.GetCHStokKodu(STOK46T.KOD(satirno),STOK46E.CH_KODU)
				Else
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				end if
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					if degiskenadi="OR_FIYAT" then Ondalik=4

					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				if degiskenadi="SIRANO" then
					Degisken=SiraNo
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin-4, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin+4, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	SatirBitis = SatirBaslangic + 10 * satiryuksekligi
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 47.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
		'If i <> 4  and i <> 6 and i <> 8 and i <>9 Then
		If i <> 5  and i <> 7 and i <> 9 and i <>10 Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next
'notlarla toplam arasýndaki dikey çizgi
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(4) , 27, 0)

	res = pe1.box(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(3), 8 , SagMargin - xCizgi(3))

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
'yatay çizgiler

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 47.5, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not2)
		
		
		If rows > 3 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 3 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"

			res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,Solmargin + 25, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120,Mesaj)

	Ondalik = Grid(7,6)

	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVOrani = STOK46E.DO_KDV_ORANI(1)

	IskontoToplami = SayiBicimle(IskontoToplami,Ondalik,1,1)
	NetTutar = SayiBicimle(NetTutar,Ondalik,1,1)
	KDVOrani = SayiBicimle(KDVOrani,Ondalik,1,1)

	KDVDahilTutar = SayiBicimle(KDVDahilTutar,Ondalik,1,1)

	sss = SatirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"GENEL TOPLAM")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(10,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "MKOD"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(9,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(10,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 12
	Grid(1,1) = 31
	Grid(2,1) = 28
	Grid(3,1) = 80
	Grid(4,1) = 25
	Grid(5,1) = 18
	Grid(6,1) = 15
	Grid(7,1) = 17
	Grid(8,1) = 20
	Grid(9,1) = 19
	Grid(10,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "TEDARÝKÇÝ KODU"
	Grid(3,2) = "STOK AÇIKLAMASI"
	Grid(4,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(5,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	Grid(9,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(10,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "D"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function

Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function

Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

'//// SATIR BÝLGÝLERÝ PROSEDÜRÜ /////
Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	sirano = sirano + 1
	satirsolmargin = solMargin + 2
	KalanSatirSayisi = S70T.GetRecCount() - i + 1 
	kalanKapasite = sayfaSatirsayisi - sirano
	
	if KalanSatirSayisi = 1 and kalanKapasite < KalanLimit then
		Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano = 1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	elseif KalanSatirSayisi < KalanLimit then
		if sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		end if
	else
		If sirano = sayfaSatirsayisi + 1 and KalanSatirSayisi > 1 Then
			Call AraSayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			sirano = 1
			Call sayfabasi(pe1)
		End If
	end if
	satirpozr = satirbaslangic + (sirano - 1) * satirYuksekligi
	if pe1.GetPageCount() > 1 and sirano = 1 then 
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , solTutar - 25, satirYuksekligi, 25, "NAKLÝ YEKÜN") 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, solTutar, satirYuksekligi, genTutar, Doc.NumFormat0(AraToplam, 20, 4)) 		
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		satirpozr = satirpozr + satirYuksekligi
		sirano = sirano + 1
	end if
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	stokkodu = S70T.KOD(i)
	Stok = StokKodu
	stokadi = Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	miktar = S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
'	lot = S70T.LOTNUMBER(i)
	tutar = S70T.TL_TUTAR(i)
	AraToplam = AraToplam + tutar
	Fiyat = s70T.TL_FIYAT(i)
	ondMiktar = Doc.SigDig(miktar)
	Miktar = Doc.NumFormat0(Miktar, 15, 2)
	ondF = Doc.SigDig(fiyat)
	if ondf =>4 and ondf > 3 then
		ondf=4
	elseif ondf=3 then
			ondf=3
	else


		ondf=2
	end if


   iskonta1 = iskonta1+s70t.TL_TISKONTO_1(i)
   iskonta2 = iskonta2+s70t.TL_TISKONTO_2(i)

	Fiyat = Doc.NumFormat0(Fiyat, 20, ondf)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(Tutar, 20, 2)

	GenTutar = 32
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 8, satirYuksekligi, 16, stok)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 25, satirYuksekligi, 59, stokadi)
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 105, satirYuksekligi, 15, miktar)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 85, satirYuksekligi, 18, LOT) 
 	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 135, satirYuksekligi, 13, fiyat) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 149, satirYuksekligi, GenTutar, tutar) 
	SolTutar = pe1.GetLeft
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
 
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
			If trim(CKSN32T.E_CKSNNO(i))= "" Then Exit Sub

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

	
 	CKSNo = CKSN32T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,32,4,10,CKSNo)
	

	Banka = CKSN32T.E_BANKA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,55,4,20,Banka)
	Sube = CKSN32T.E_SUBE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,75,4,30,Sube) 
'	Sehir = CKSN32T.E_SEHIR(i)
'	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
'	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,106,4,10,Seh)
'	BCHNo = CKSN32T.E_HESAPNO(i)
'	Orjcksno=CKSN32T.E_OREVRAKNO(i)
'	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,117,4,40,trim(orjcksno)&" "&"/"&" "&BCHNo) 

	VTar = CKSN32T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,107,4,25,VTarih)

Sub Etiket(d7LB, pe1,satirNo)

  	    res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 36)
	    res = pe1.Write(Ust+12*Aralik-5, solMargin +Genislik2+84 ,15, 15,"H")
     else
       if trim(StokKodu) = "8921 751" then 
  	      res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 16)
	      res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	      res = pe1.Write(Ust+4*Aralik-4, solMargin +Genislik2+20,10, 80, "CABLE SUP. GH1")
	      res = pe1.Write(Ust+4*Aralik+4, solMargin +Genislik2+10,10, 90, "MECANISME DE PORTE ARR")
  	      res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 18)
	      res = pe1.Write(Ust+12*Aralik, solMargin +Genislik2+10 , 10, 80,"INDICE MODIFICATION")
  	      res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 36)
	      res = pe1.Write(Ust+12*Aralik-5, solMargin +Genislik2+84 ,15, 15,"H")
       else
  	      res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	      res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	      res = pe1.Write(Ust+4*Aralik, solMargin +Genislik2  , 10, SagMargin-Genislik2-Genislik1-SolMargin, ChStokAdi)
  	      res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 18)
	      res = pe1.Write(Ust+12*Aralik, solMargin +Genislik2+10 , 10, 80,"INDICE MODIFICATION")
  	      'res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 36)
	      'res = pe1.Write(Ust+12*Aralik-5, solMargin +Genislik2+84 ,15, 15,"H")
       end if
     end if
   end if
  end if

 
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(Ust+7*Aralik, solMargin +Genislik2+2  , 10, SagMargin-Genislik2-Genislik1-SolMargin , "REF. FOURNISSEUR (30S)")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'	res = pe1.Barcode(Ust+8*Aralik-1, solMargin + Genislik2+Genislik1+3 ,3*Aralik, BarkodGen, "CODE39", trim(d7LB.KOD(satirNo)), "")

	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi("30S   " & SeriNo)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(0,0)

	res = pe1.Write(Ust+8*Aralik-2, solMargin + Genislik2+Genislik1+3, 8, BarkodGen, trim(StokKodu))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Barcode(pe1.GetTop + Aralik + 1, solMargin + Genislik2+Genislik1+3 ,2*Aralik, BarkodGen, "CODE39", trim(SeriNo), "")


	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : CAVO_2016 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : STOK26-1
Hangi Tablo için : STOK26
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için :

Kod : 
Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi, ToplamTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Depolar Arasý Transfer Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK26T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK26T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 6
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 10
'	satirSonu = AltMargin 
	satirSonu = AltMargin - (3 * satiryuksekligi)
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23

	Blok20 = SolMargin + 100
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 121

	Blok30 = SolMargin + 170
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 191


	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1
	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6
	FisNo = STOK26E.EVRAKNO(1)
	MpsNo = STOK26E.FORW_MPSNO(1)
	MamulKod = STOK26E.FORW_CODE(1)

	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK26E.TARIH(1))
	CikisAmbarKodu = STOK26E.AMBCODE(1)
	CikisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",CikisAmbarKodu,"")  
	GirisAmbarKodu = STOK26E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)
	GirisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",GirisAmbarKodu,"")  

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Veren Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(CikisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(CikisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Alan Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(GirisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(GirisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Evrak No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FisNo)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)


	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Ýþemri No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & MpsNo)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Mamul Kodu")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & MamulKod)



	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1		
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)		
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK26T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			elseIf DegiskenAdi = "_SIPNOTU" Then
				SiparisArtikelNo = STOK26T.ALLOC_SIPARTNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T","NOTES",SiparisArtikelNo,"ARTNO")
			elseIf DegiskenAdi = "_ISEMRINO" Then
				Degisken =STOK26E.FORW_MPSNO(1)
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin -(3*satirYuksekligi)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.Box(Enalt, solmargin,3*satirYuksekligi,sagmargin-solmargin)  
	res= pe1.Setbold(1)
	res= pe1.Setalign("left")
	res= pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",12)

	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(3*satirYuksekligi), Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(2*satirYuksekligi), Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")
	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(3*satirYuksekligi), ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "TESLÝM EDEN")
	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(2*satirYuksekligi), ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")

	res= pe1.write(Enalt, Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	res= pe1.write(Enalt+1*satirYuksekligi, Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")
	res= pe1.write(Enalt, ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "TESLÝM EDEN")
	res= pe1.write(Enalt+1*satirYuksekligi, ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")

	res= pe1.Setbold(0)
	res= pe1.Setalign("left")
	res= pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",8)
	res= pe1.write(Enalt+3*satirYuksekligi, Solmargin,(1*satirYuksekligi),100, "F163 Rev1 Yayýn Tarihi:18/11/2008")


End Sub


Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_ISEMRINO"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "_SIPNOTU"


	Grid(0,1) = 11		
	Grid(1,1) = 20		
	Grid(2,1) = 41		
	Grid(3,1) = 70		
	Grid(4,1) = 25		
	Grid(5,1) = 30		
	Grid(6,1) = 25		
	Grid(7,1) = 13		
	Grid(8,1) = 50		


	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"			
	Grid(1,2) = "Ýþemri No"			
	Grid(2,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Malzeme Cinsi"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Miktar"				
	Grid(7,2) = "Birim"	
	Grid(8,2) = "Sipariþ Notu"							

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "C"	
	Grid(6,4) = "N"	
	Grid(7,4) = "C"	
	Grid(8,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK26T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))

		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6

	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23

	Blok20 = SolMargin + 100
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 121

	Blok30 = SolMargin + 170
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 191


	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1
	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6
	FisNo = STOK83E.EVRAKNO(1)
	'MpsNo = STOK83E.FORW_MPSNO(1)
	MamulKod = STOK83E.NOTES(1)

	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK83E.TARIH(1))
	CikisAmbarKodu = STOK83E.AMBCODE(1)
	CikisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",CikisAmbarKodu,"")  
	GirisAmbarKodu = STOK83E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Alan Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(GirisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(GirisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Evrak No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FisNo)

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK83T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			elseIf DegiskenAdi = "_SIPNOTU" Then
				'SiparisArtikelNo = STOK83T.ALLOC_SIPARTNO(satirNo)
				Degisken = ""
			elseIf DegiskenAdi = "_ISEMRINO" Then
				Degisken =""
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.Box(Enalt, solmargin,3*satirYuksekligi,sagmargin-solmargin)  
	res= pe1.Setbold(1)
	res= pe1.Setalign("left")
	res= pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",12)

	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(3*satirYuksekligi), Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(2*satirYuksekligi), Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")
	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(3*satirYuksekligi), ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "TESLÝM EDEN")
	'res= pe1.write(Enalt-(2*satirYuksekligi), ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")

	res= pe1.write(Enalt, Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	res= pe1.write(Enalt+1*satirYuksekligi, Solmargin+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),sagmargin/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")
	res= pe1.write(Enalt, ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "TESLÝM EDEN")
	res= pe1.write(Enalt+1*satirYuksekligi, ((sagmargin-solmargin)/2)+10,(1*satirYuksekligi),(sagmargin-solmargin)/2, "AD SOYAD ÝMZA:")

	res= pe1.Setbold(0)
	res= pe1.Setalign("left")
	res= pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",8)
	res= pe1.write(Enalt+3*satirYuksekligi, Solmargin,(1*satirYuksekligi),100, "F163 Rev1 Yayýn Tarihi:18/11/2008")


End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "MPSNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "_SIPNOTU"


	Grid(0,1) = 11		
	Grid(1,1) = 20		
	Grid(2,1) = 41		
	Grid(3,1) = 70		
	Grid(4,1) = 25		
	Grid(5,1) = 30		
	Grid(6,1) = 25		
	Grid(7,1) = 13		
	Grid(8,1) = 50		


	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"			
	Grid(1,2) = "Ýþemri No"			
	Grid(2,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Malzeme Cinsi"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Miktar"				
	Grid(7,2) = "Birim"	
	Grid(8,2) = "Sipariþ Notu"							

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "C"	
	Grid(6,4) = "N"	
	Grid(7,4) = "C"	
	Grid(8,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK83T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
