Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Fason Üretim Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	STOK68T.SafePack()
	For I = 1 To STOK68T.GetRecCount()
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

		End If
	Next
	if uBound(xCizgi) > 0 Then
		Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1)
	End if

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(28, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 0.5
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then	
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			Degisken = STOK68T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			Degisken1 = Degisken
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
				Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK68T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		if BosMu(i) Then
			Grid(i,1) = 0
		End if
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Grid(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK68T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilacakAlan, ToplamGen)
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function BosMu(KolonNo)
	BosMu = True
	AlanAdi = Grid(KolonNo,0)
	AlanTuru = Grid(KolonNo,4)
	if AlanTuru = "N" Then
		for i = 1 to STOK68T.GetRowCount()
			if trim(STOK68T.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)) <> 0 Then
				BosMu = False
				Exit Function
			End if
		Next
		Exit Function
	End if
	for i = 1 to STOK68T.GetRowCount()
		if trim(STOK68T.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)) <> "" Then
			BosMu = False
			Exit Function
		End if
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()

	sagMargin = 200
	ustmargin=10
	solmargin=10
	satirno=0

	satirBaslangic3 = 157

	res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Listeleri",297,210,"")

	satirSayisi2 = SRVK00.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi2

		Call SatirYazdir1(pe1,i)
		
	Next

	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir1(pe1, i)
	Dim satirpozr2
	Dim satirpozr3
	If satirno >= 5 Then
		
		Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
		
		Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		satirpozr2 = satirBaslangic2
		satirpozr3 = satirBaslangic3
	Else
		If satirno = 1 Then
			satirpozr2 = satirBaslangic2
			satirpozr3 = satirBaslangic3
		Else
			satirpozr2 = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
			satirpozr3 = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	i=i+1	
	
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.0)
	
	
	for z=1 to SRVK00Z.Getreccount()
		if z<=3 then
					if z=1 then
						satirpozr5=satirpozr2+27
					else
						satirpozr5=pe1.getbottom
					end if
	prosedurkod=SRVK00Z.PROSEDUR_KODU(z)
	proseduracik=SRVK00Z.PROSEDUR_ACIKLAMASI(z)	
	prosedurnot=SRVK00Z.PROSEDUR_NOTU(z)
	prosedurnot=Replace(prosedurnot,vbCR+vbLF,"")
	
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr5,solmargin+2,12,180,trim(proseduracik) & " : " & trim(prosedurnot))
		end if
	next

	for l=1 to SRVK00L.Getreccount()
		if l<=3 then
					if l=1 then
						satirpozr6=satirpozr5+33
					else
						satirpozr6=pe1.getbottom
					end if	
	
	'kontrolkodu=SRVK00L.CHECKLISTKODU(l)	
	aciklama=SRVK00L.ACIKLAMA(l)	
	islemacik=SRVK00L.ISLEM(l)	
	kimyapti=SRVK00L.KIMYAPTI(l)	
	
	
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr6,solmargin+2,6,50,kontrolkodu)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr6,solmargin+50,6,50,aciklama)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr6,solmargin+100,6,50,islemacik)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr6,solmargin+150,6,50,kimyapti)	
		end if
	next

End sub

Sub PrintLabel()
	par1=SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME

	'Set STOK25T = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.ETIKET","GetEtiketTable", par1)
	'	Set STOK25T  = Doc.Select1("_D7KIDSLB1", "D7KIDSLB", "KOD="&D7KIDSLB.KOD, "", -1)

	
	if STOK25T.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 76
	sayfaEni = 100

	Ustmargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 74
	EtiketEni = 100
	EtiketlerArasi = 0
	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = EtiketEni - 2

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Etiket", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
'	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
'	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	For i = 1 to STOK25T.GetRecCount()
		if i > 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
		Call Etiket( pe1,i)
	Next 

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Etiket( pe1,satirNo)
	StokKodu = STOK25T.NEWCODE(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	LotNo = STOK25T.NEWLOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	SeriNo = STOK25T.NEWSERINO(satirNo)
	Miktar = STOK25T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	Birim = STOK25T.OSF_SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	'BarkodNo = STOK25T.KOD(satirNo)
	Tarih = STOK25E.TARIH
	'Tedarikci = STOK25T.CH_TEDARIKCI(satirNo)
	'TedarikciAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Tedarikci, "")
	AnaKod = Doc.Kod_SeviyeAl(StokKodu, -1)
	Kontrol= TRIM(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_B_TECH_10", StokKodu , ""))

	Ust = Ustmargin
	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
	
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\NET LOGO RENKSIZ.jpg"
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust, solMargin, 10, 10, logo, 114)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(Ust, pe1.GetRight + 10, 10, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 10, "MALZEME TRANSFER ETÝKETÝ")

	Aralik = 6
	Basla = Ust + 10
	Genislik = 20

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(Basla, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "TEDARÝKÇÝ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 6, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1, ": " & TedarikciAdi)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + Aralik, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "PARÇA ADI")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 12)
	'res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 6, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 5, ": " & StokAdi)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 6, 60 , ": " & StokAdi)


	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + Aralik, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "Parça Kodu")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 8, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1, ": " & StokKodu)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + Aralik + 1, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "LOT NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 6, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1, ": " & LotNo)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + Aralik, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "SERÝ NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 6, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1, ": " & SeriNo)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + Aralik, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "MÝKTAR")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 18)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop - 2, pe1.GetRight + 1, 10, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1, ": " & Doc.NumFormat(Miktar, 20, Doc.SigDig(Miktar)) & " " & Birim)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 12)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + Aralik + 2, solMargin, 6, Genislik, "TARIH")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 6, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Tarih))

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 16)
	if kontrol<>"" then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 8, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,  "AQP")
	else
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 8, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,  "NAQP")
	end if


	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial Narrow", 8)
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(BarkodNo)
	res = pe1.Barcode(pe1.GetTop + Aralik, solMargin + 5, 13, BarkodGen, "CODE128", trim(BarkodNo), "")

End Sub
Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Sub PrintForm()

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Listeleri",297,210,"")
	BaslangicSayfaNo = pe1.GetPageCount
	OperasyonSatirNo = 0
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next	
	BitisSayfaNo = pe1.GetPageCount
	sayfaSayisi = BitisSayfaNo - BaslangicSayfaNo + 1
	For i=1 To sayfaSayisi 
		res = pe1.GoToPage(BaslangicSayfaNo + i - 1)
		Baslik = i &  " / " & sayfaSayisi	
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(282,10,6,190,"- \b Sayfa : \b0  " & Baslik & " -") 	   
	Next   
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirNo)
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	iSatir = 5.25
	'satirSonu = 272
	satirSonu = 290

	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(satirNo)
	If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
		rSiraNo = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo))
		For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j))
			KaynakTipi1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j))
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				n=n+1
			End If
		Next
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10*iSatir
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			 siraNo = 1
			 res = pe1.PageBreak()
			 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			 satirpozr = 85
		Else
			 If satirNo = 1 Or OperasyonSatirNo = 0 Then
				  satirpozr = 85
			 Else
				  satirpozr = pe1.GetBottom() + satiryuksekligi
			 End If
			 siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
			
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",IsMerkeziKodu,-1)
		OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
		OperasyonAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
		MamulPaketSayisi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketSayisi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = FormatNumber(YariMamulPaketIcerigi,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari1 = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamYariMamulMiktari1,20,0)
		BaslamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MMPS10T.R_LATEST_B_TARIH(SatirNo))
		BitisTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MMPS10T.R_LATEST_E_TARIH(SatirNo))
		ToplamSure = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(SatirNo)
		BirimSure = Doc.Div(ToplamSure, ToplamYariMamulMiktari1) * 3600
		AyarSuresi = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR1(SatirNo) * 60
		ReceteNotu = MMPS10T.RECETENOTU(SatirNo)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		m = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
		If m > 0 Then
			Boy = 5 * iSatir	+ 3
		Else
			Boy = 6 * iSatir - 2 
		End If 
		
		BaslikBasla = SatirPozr - 3
		ToplamSatir = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) + MuhendislikSatir(SatirNo)
		DisBoy = ToplamSatir + 4 * iSatir

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
'		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(118,216,195))
		res = pe1.NoPen()
'		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla, 10,Boy,190)
		res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
		res = pe1.NoPen()
'barkodun arka planý
'		res = pe1.Box(satirPozr -3, 10,Boy,20)

'gerçekleþen kutularý
'		res = pe1.Box(satirpozr + iSatir - 1, 170,6,25)
'		res = pe1.Box(satirpozr + 2 * iSatir - 1,170, 6,25)

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		If MuhendislikSatir(SatirNo) > 0 Then
			res = pe1.Line(BaslikBasla + Boy,10,0,190)						
		End If

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

	'	res = pe1.SetRotation(270)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		ArtNo = "%JB%" & trim(MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo))
		pe1.NoPen()
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(ArtNo)

		'res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
		'res = pe1.Barcode(satirPozr, 12,15,4 * iSatir + 2,"CODE128",ArtNo,"")
		
		res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	res = pe1.Barcode(satirPozr , 20,15,BarkodGen  ,"CODE39", ArtNo,"")

	'	res = pe1.SetRotation(0)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)

satirpozr=satirpozr+14

		'res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,32,6,25,"Ýþ Merkezi")
	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,45,6,25,"Ýþ Merkezi")

		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

'---------------------------

		'res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,60,6,60,": " & trim(IsMerkeziKodu) & " - " & trim(IsMerkeziAdi))
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,70,6,60,": " & trim(IsMerkeziKodu) & " - " & trim(IsMerkeziAdi))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,45,6,25,"Operasyon")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir ,70,6,60,": " & trim(OperasyonKodu) & " - " & trim(OperasyonAdi))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,45,6,25,"Üretim Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,70,6,13,": " & ToplamYariMamulMiktari)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		for i = 1 to 4
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop, pe1.GetRight + 2,6,15,"................")		
		Next
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,45,6,25,"Ayar Süresi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,70,6,60,": " & Doc.Round(AyarSuresi,1) & " dk")

		if trim(ReceteNotu) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
			res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 4*iSatir,45,6,25,"DÝKKAT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 4*iSatir,70,6,60,": " & trim(ReceteNotu))
			res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		End if
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,145,6,25,"Planlanan")
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,170,6,25,"Gerçekleþen")
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
'		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,150,6,20,"ONAY   :")

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirpozr + isatir - 2,145,0,25)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirpozr + isatir - 2,170,0,25)
		Blok20 = 145
		Blok21 = Blok20 + 30

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,Blok20,6,25,"Baþlama Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,Blok21,6,25,": " & BaslamaTarihi)
		
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,Blok20,6,25,"Bitiþ Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,Blok21,6,25,": " & BitisTarihi)

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2 * iSatir,Blok20,6,25,"Birim Süre")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2 * iSatir,Blok21,6,25,": " & Doc.Round(BirimSure,2) & " s")

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3 * iSatir,Blok20,6,25, "Toplam Süre")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3 * iSatir,Blok21,6,25, ": " & Doc.Round(ToplamSure,2) & " saat")

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

'mühendislik tanýmlarý
		satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom()
		BaslikBitis = satirPozr
		Call MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)

'		satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2 * iSatir		
		If MuhendislikSatir(SatirNo) > 0 Then
			HSatirBaslangic = satirpozr + iSatir
		Else
			HSatirBaslangic = BaslikBasla + Boy
		End If
		If m > 0 Then
			res = pe1.Line(HSatirBaslangic+10,10,0,190)						
		End If 

		HSatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 5
		For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j)
			KaynakTipi1 = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j)
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				sonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
				If sonSatir1 >= satirSonu Then
			  		 res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,sonSatir1 - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
					 siraNo = 1
					 res = pe1.PageBreak()
					 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					 satirpozr = 92
					 BaslikBasla = 89
					 HSatirBaslangic = 92
					 k = 0
				End If
				res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
				res = pe1.UseSet(1)

				res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
				HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(j)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,12,6,35,HammaddeKodu)

				HammaddeAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,50,6,80,HammaddeAdi)

				HammaddeMiktar = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j)
				HammaddeMiktar = FormatNumber(HammaddeMiktar,0,,,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,155,6,30,HammaddeMiktar)

				HammaddeBirim = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,188,6,10,HammaddeBirim)
				k = k + 1
			End If
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		Next
		If m > 0 Then
			HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
		Else
			HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
		end if
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,HSatirSonu - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
		OperasyonSatirNo = OperasyonSatirNo + 1
	End If 
End Sub
Sub MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	satirYuksekligi	= 7

	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)
	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")
	SatirSayisi = Tech.GetRecCount()
	If SatirSayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		Tanim = Tech.TSTEXT(i)		
		satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,165,Tanim)
	Next
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,Doc.SigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,87,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")

		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirYuksekligi = 6
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Sub PrintForm()   

Dim pe1
	OperasyonSatirNo = 0
	ustmargin=25
	solmargin=10
	sayi=0
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Cavo Ýþ Emri Formu",297,210,"")
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()

	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next	
		
	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirNo)

	satirYuksekligi = 5
	iSatir = 7
	satirSonu = 272
	
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(satirNo)

	If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
		sayi=sayi+1
		'if sayi <> 1 then
		'	res=pe1.pagebreak
		'	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		'end if

'Sýra numaralarý sorgulanýyor.
   	rSiraNo = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo))
   	For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j))
			KaynakTipi1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j))
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				n=n+1
			End If
		Next

'****************************
		
		'sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10*iSatir
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 4*iSatir


		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			 siraNo = 1
			 res = pe1.PageBreak()
			 'satirpozr = 90
				Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = 50

		Else
			 If satirNo = 1 Or OperasyonSatirNo = 0 Then
				  satirpozr = 50
					'satirpozr = 25
			 Else
				  satirpozr = pe1.GetBottom() + satiryuksekligi+10
			 End If
			 siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
			
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",IsMerkeziKodu,-1)
		OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
		OperasyonAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
		MamulPaketSayisi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketSayisi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = FormatNumber(YariMamulPaketIcerigi,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
		BaslamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MMPS10T.R_LATEST_B_TARIH(SatirNo))
		BitisTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MMPS10T.R_LATEST_E_TARIH(SatirNo))

		sure=MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(SatirNo)
		if trim(MMPS10T.OPERATORSAYISI1(SatirNo))>0 then
			AdamSayisi= MMPS10T.OPERATORSAYISI1(SatirNo)
		else
			AdamSayisi=1
		end if
		ToplamAdamSaat= sure * AdamSayisi 
		ToplamAdamDakika= ToplamAdamSaat * 60
		Cevrim= DOC.DIV(sure * 3600 , ToplamYariMamulMiktari)
		ToplamAdamDakika = FormatNumber(ToplamAdamDakika,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = FormatNumber(ToplamYariMamulMiktari,0,,,-1)

		
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		m = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
		If m > 0 Then
			Boy = 3 * iSatir	+ 5
		Else
			Boy = 4 * iSatir - 2
		End If 
		
		BaslikBasla = SatirPozr - 3
		ToplamSatir = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) 
		DisBoy = ToplamSatir + 3 * iSatir

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
		
		res = pe1.NoPen()
'barkodun arka planý
		res = pe1.Box(satirPozr -3, 10,Boy,20)

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)


		'res = pe1.SetRotation(270)
		ArtNo = MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)
		pe1.NoPen()

     If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
       'res=pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)

  		  res = pe1.Barcode(satirPozr+22 ,12,15,7 * iSatir,"CODE128","%JB%" & trim(ArtNo),"")
     End If

		'res = pe1.SetRotation(0)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)

		'res = pe1.Line(satirpozr - iSatir+2,solmargin,0,150)
   	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr - iSatir+3,45,7,88,"/  Sýra No:"&rsiraNo)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,12,6,25,"Ýþ Merkezi ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,41,6,80,": " & trim(IsMerkeziKodu) & " - " & trim(IsMerkeziAdi))
		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,12,6,25,"Operasyon ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,41,6,60,": " & trim(OperasyonKodu) & " - " & trim(OperasyonAdi))

		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,145,6,60,"Sonraki Operasyon:"&sonrakiOp)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,145,6,50,"Op.süresi:")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,165,6,20,": "& trim(sure))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,12,6,25,"Üretim Miktarý ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,41,6,30,": " & ToplamYarimamulMiktari)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,70,6,15,"Kiþi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,85,6,15,": " & AdamSayisi)


		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,100,6,15,"Çevrim")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,115,6,20, ": " & Doc.NumFormat(Cevrim,5,1) & " sn")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight + 1,6,10,"Setup")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight + 1,6,20," : " & MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR1(SatirNo) * 60 & " dk")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight + 1,6,20,"Adam Dakika")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight + 1,5,20," : " & ToplamAdamDakika)



		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,105,6,35,"Birim Miktar")
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,130,6,35,"Kullanýlacak Miktar")
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 3*iSatir,165,6,25,"Parti No:")
		
		HSatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 12
		For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j)
			KaynakTipi1 = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j)
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				sonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
				If sonSatir1 >= satirSonu Then
			  		 res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,sonSatir1 - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
					 siraNo = 1
					 res = pe1.PageBreak()
'**********

					 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					 'satirpozr = 92
						satirpozr = 50
					 BaslikBasla = 52
					 HSatirBaslangic = 52
					 k = 0
				End If
				res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
				If (k Mod 2) = 0 Then
					res = pe1.NoPen()					
					res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
    				res = pe1.Box(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir - 1,10,6,190)
				End If
				res = pe1.UseSet(1)

				res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",8)
				HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(j)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,12,6,35,HammaddeKodu)

				HammaddeAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,35,6,100,HammaddeAdi)

				HammaddeMiktar = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				ondalik = doc.sigdig(MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j))
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,123,6,20,doc.numformat(HammaddeMiktar,12, 0))
				paketicerik=MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI
				birimm=Doc.div(Hammaddemiktar,paketicerik)
				res = pe1.Write(HsatirBaslangic+k*iSatir,88,6,35,doc.numformat(birimm,10,4))

				HammaddeBirim = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,145,6,8,HammaddeBirim)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,165,6,25,"------------")

				k = k + 1
			End If
		Next
		HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,HSatirSonu - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
		OperasyonSatirNo = OperasyonSatirNo + 1
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

		ustmargin=150
		solmargin=50

		res=pe1.Setbold(0)
		res =pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)

		res = pe1.Line(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir+2,10,0,150)

		
	End If 
End Sub


Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)	
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,MMPS10T.maxSigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,100,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")
	 		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,105,6,35,HammaddeMiktari)

		End If
	
	Next
	
End Sub

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Sub PrintLabel()
	par1=SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME

	Set d7LB = Doc.RunMacro1("MAKR7S.ETIKET-1","GetEtiketTable", par1)

	if d7LB.GetRowCount() = 0 Then Exit Sub

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 100
	sayfaEni = 150

	Ustmargin = 2
	EtiketBoyu = 98
	EtiketEni = 150
	EtiketlerArasi = 0
	solMargin = 3
	sagMargin = EtiketEni - 2

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Etiket", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
'	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
'	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	For i = 1 to d7LB.GetRecCount()
		if i > 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
		Call Etiket(d7LB, pe1,i)
	Next 

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Etiket(d7LB, pe1,satirNo)
	StokKodu = d7LB.SKOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	LotNo = d7LB.LOTNUMBER(satirNo)
	SeriNo = d7LB.SERINO(satirNo)
	Miktar = d7LB.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	Birim = d7LB.SF_UNIT(satirNo)
	BarkodNo = d7LB.KOD(satirNo)
	Tarih = d7LB.REFTARIH1(satirNo)
	Tedarikci = d7LB.CH_TEDARIKCI(satirNo)
	Musteri = d7LB.CH_MUSTERI(satirNo)

	TedarikciAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Tedarikci, "")
	MusteriAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Musteri, "")

	AnaKod = Doc.Kod_SeviyeAl(StokKodu, -1)

	ChStokKodu = doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,Musteri)


	Ust = Ustmargin
	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
	
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust, solMargin, 10, 10, logo, 114)

	Aralik = 5
	Basla = Ust + 10
	Genislik1 = 12
	Genislik2 = 46

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Ust+Aralik-4, solMargin +Genislik1  , 10, sagMargin-solMargin - Genislik1 , "ÜRETÝCÝ FÝRMA: CAVO OTOMOTÝV SAN. TÝC. A.Þ.")
	'res = pe1.Write(Ust+2*Aralik-2, solMargin +Genislik1, 10, sagMargin-solMargin - Genislik1, "Müþteri: PRESSAN SAN. TÝC. A.Þ.")
	res = pe1.Write(Ust+2*Aralik-2, solMargin +Genislik1, 10, sagMargin-solMargin - Genislik1, "Müþteri: " & MusteriAdi)

	res= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res= pe1.box(ust,Solmargin,3*Aralik , sagMArgin-SolMargin)
	res= pe1.box(ust+3*Aralik,Solmargin,13*Aralik , 12)
	res= pe1.box(ust+16*Aralik,Solmargin,12, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res= pe1.box(ust+14*Aralik,Solmargin+Genislik1,2*Aralik, sagMargin-SolMargin-Genislik1)

	res= pe1.Line(ust+14*Aralik,Solmargin+Genislik2,2*Aralik, 0)

	res= pe1.Line(ust+16*Aralik,Solmargin+Genislik2,12, 0)
	res= pe1.Line(ust+16*Aralik,Solmargin+2*Genislik2,12, 0)
	res= pe1.Line(ust,sagMargin,EtiketBoyu-Basla , 0)

	res = pe1.setrotation(90)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(ust + 3*Aralik, solMargin, 4*Aralik, 6, "CavoRef:")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)


'	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
'	res = pe1.Write(ust + 7*Aralik, solMargin, 7*Aralik, 8, StokKodu)
	res = pe1.Write(ust + 7*Aralik, solMargin, 7*Aralik, 8, StokKodu)

	res = pe1.setrotation(0)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+16*Aralik, solMargin, 6, Genislik2, "Üretim Tarihi:")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+16*Aralik+5, solMargin, 6, Genislik2, Tarih)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+16*Aralik, solMargin + Genislik2, 6, Genislik2, "Lot No:")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+16*Aralik+5, solMargin +Genislik2, 6, Genislik2, LotNo)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+16*Aralik, solMargin + 2*Genislik2, 6, Genislik2, "Miktar:")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+16*Aralik+5, solMargin + 2*Genislik2, 6, Genislik2, Miktar)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+3*Aralik, solMargin + Genislik1, 6, 20, "OEM REF:")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 80)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	'res = pe1.Write(ust+4*Aralik, solMargin + Genislik1, 40, sagMargin-SolMargin-Genislik1, ChStokKodu)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+2*Aralik, solMargin + Genislik2, 40, sagMargin-SolMargin-Genislik2, ChStokKodu)



End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satirAra
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar, tutar, soltutar, solgen, satiryuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	SOLTUTAR=0
	SOLGEN=0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 19
	SolMargin = 13
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	satiryuksekligi=5
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýþ Sözleþmesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	satirSonu = UstMargin + 220
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 140

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
satirSayisi = CARI20T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)

		res = pe1.nopen()
      Tarih=doc.strtonordate(CARI20E.TARIH )
'*******************
		Set bnk0c = Doc.Select1("ABC","BNK00C","KOD='"+CARI20T.KOD(1)+"&TRNUM='"+"000001"+"'","",-1)
		for i=1 to bnk0c.getreccount
			bankakodu = BNK0C.BANKA_KODU(i)
			Banka_adi= doc.getdbfieldvalue("BNK00", "AD", Bankakodu, "")

			subekodu = BNK0C.SUBE_KODU(i)
			hesapno = BNK0C.HESAPNO(i)
       ibanno = BNK0C.IBAN(i)
		Next
		Set BNK00t2 = Doc.Select1("ABCffxvcx","BNK00T","SUBE_KODU='"+subekodu+"'","",-1)
								for y=1 to bnk00t2.getreccount
									if trim(bnk00t2.KOD(y))=trim(bankakodu) then
										sube_adi=bnk00t2.SUBE_ADI(y)
									END IF
								next
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50 ,banka_adi )
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, Sagmargin-30, satiryuksekligi, 30 ,tarih )
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50 ,sube_adi)
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*10, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50 ,"MÜDÜRLÜÐÜ")
		not1= "ÞUBENÝZ NEZDÝNDE BULUNAN "& trim(Hesapno) & " NOLU HESABIMIZDAN AÞAÐIDA"
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*16, Solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 150 ,not1)
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*17, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 150 ,"DÖKÜMÜ YAZILI OLAN BANKALARA HAVALE YAPILMASINI RÝCA EDERÝZ.")
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*19, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 150 ,"Saygýlarýmýzla")




		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 10, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)

		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		kod=CARI20T.KARSI_CODE(satirno)
		Set BNK0C1 = Doc.Select1("ABCxxxxx","BNK00C","KOD='"+kod+"&TRNUM='"+"000001"+"'","",-1)
		for c=1 to BNK0C1.getreccount
			bankakodu = BNK0C1.BANKA_KODU(c)
			subekodu = BNK0C1.SUBE_KODU(c)
			hesapno = BNK0C1.HESAPNO(c)
       ibanno = BNK0C1.IBAN(c) 
		Next
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)



		If trim(CARI20T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		satiryuksekligi = 5
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
			End If
		End If		
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				select case degiskenadi
							Case  "KARSI_CODE"
								if trim(doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", kod, ""))="" then
									Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", kod, "")
								else
									Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", kod, "")
								end if
							Case  "KBANKA_ADI"
								Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("BNK00", "AD", Bankakodu, "")
							Case  "KSUBENO"
								Degisken = subekodu
							Case  "KSUBE_ADI"
								Set BNK00t1 = Doc.Select1("ABCffxx","BNK00T","SUBE_KODU='"+subekodu+"'","",-1)
								for v=1 to bnk00t1.getreccount
									if trim(bnk00t1.KOD(v))=trim(bankakodu) then
										degisken=bnk00t1.SUBE_ADI(v)
									end if
								next
							Case  "KHESAPNO"
								Degisken = hesapno
							Case  "KIBAN"
								Degisken = ibanno

				case else
					Degisken = trim(cstr(CARI20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				end select
				if degiskenadi="CH_ALACAKFIYAT" then
						Tutar=tutar+CARI20T.CH_ALACAKFIYAT(satirno)
						soltutar=sol
						solgen=sutungenisligi-2
				end if
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getbottom+satiryuksekligi, Soltutar-45, 15,35,"TOPLAM")
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.gettop, Soltutar, 15,solgen,doc.numformat(tutar,12,2))
	tutar=0
					res = pe1.SetAlign("left")
		res = pe1.setbold(0)

'logolar
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGOM"))
	logoc = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataRoot() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGOC"))

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,6)
	Grid(0,0) = "KARSI_CODE"
	Grid(1,0) = "KBANKA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "KSUBE_ADI"
	Grid(3,0) = "KIBAN"
	Grid(4,0) = "CH_ALACAKFIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "CH_KUR"

	Grid(0,1) = 65
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 30
	Grid(3,1) = 50
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "Hesap Adý"
	Grid(1,2) = "Banka Adý"
	Grid(2,2) = "Banka Þube"
	Grid(3,2) = "Iban No"
	Grid(4,2) = "Tutar"
	Grid(5,2) = ""

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"



	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = CARI20T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		'res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satirAra
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar, tutar, soltutar, solgen, satiryuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	SOLTUTAR=0
	SOLGEN=0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 30
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 19
	SolMargin = 13
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	satiryuksekligi=5
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýþ Sözleþmesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	satirSonu = UstMargin + 220
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 140

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = CARI20T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)

		res = pe1.nopen()
      Tarih=doc.strtonordate(CARI20E.TARIH )
'*******************
		Set bnk0c = Doc.Select1("ABC","BNK00C","KOD='"+CARI20T.KOD(1)+"&TRNUM='"+"000001"+"'","",-1)
		for i=1 to bnk0c.getreccount
			bankakodu = BNK0C.BANKA_KODU(i)
			Banka_adi= doc.getdbfieldvalue("BNK00", "AD", Bankakodu, "")

			subekodu = BNK0C.SUBE_KODU(i)
			hesapno = BNK0C.HESAPNO(i)
       ibanno  = BNK0C.IBAN(i)
 

		Next
		Set BNK00t2 = Doc.Select1("ABCffxvcx","BNK00T","SUBE_KODU='"+subekodu+"'","",-1)
								for y=1 to bnk00t2.getreccount
									if trim(bnk00t2.KOD(y))=trim(bankakodu) then
										sube_adi=bnk00t2.SUBE_ADI(y)
									END IF
								next
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50 ,banka_adi )
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, Sagmargin-30, satiryuksekligi, 30 ,tarih )
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*12, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50 ,sube_adi)
					res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*13, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50 ,"MÜDÜRLÜÐÜ")
		not1= "ÞUBENÝZ NEZDÝNDE BULUNAN "& trim(Hesapno) & " NOLU HESABIMIZDAN AÞAÐIDA"
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*16, Solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 150 ,not1)
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*17, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 150 ,"DÖKÜMÜ YAZILI OLAN BANKALARA EFT YAPILMASINI RÝCA EDERÝZ.")
		res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*19, Solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 150 ,"Saygýlarýmýzla")




		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
		Sol = SolMargin
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 10, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)

		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		kod=CARI20T.KARSI_CODE(satirno)
		Qstr="SELECT * FROM BNK00C WHERE KOD='"&kod&"' AND VARSAYILAN='E'"
		Set BNK0C1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("123dfg",Qstr)
		if BNK0C1.getreccount>0 Then
			bankakodu = BNK0C1.BANKA_KODU(1)
			subekodu = BNK0C1.SUBE_KODU(1)
			hesapno = BNK0C1.HESAPNO(1)
     ibanno  = BNK0C1.IBAN(1)
  End if
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)

		If trim(CARI20T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		satiryuksekligi = 5
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
			End If
		End If		
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				select case degiskenadi
							Case  "KARSI_CODE"
								if trim(doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", kod, ""))="" then
									Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", kod, "")
								else
									Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", kod, "")
								end if
							Case  "KBANKA_ADI"
								Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("BNK00", "AD", Bankakodu, "")
							Case  "KSUBENO"
								Degisken = subekodu
							Case  "KSUBE_ADI"
								Set BNK00t1 = Doc.Select1("ABCffxx","BNK00T","SUBE_KODU='"+subekodu+"'","",-1)
								for v=1 to bnk00t1.getreccount
									if trim(bnk00t1.KOD(v))=trim(bankakodu) then
										degisken=bnk00t1.SUBE_ADI(v)
									end if
								next
							Case  "KHESAPNO"
								Degisken = hesapno
                 Case "KIBAN"
                   Degisken = ibanno
				case else
					Degisken = trim(cstr(CARI20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				end select
				if degiskenadi="CH_ALACAKFIYAT" then
						Tutar=tutar+CARI20T.CH_ALACAKFIYAT(satirno)
						soltutar=sol
						solgen=sutungenisligi-2
				end if
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "C" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

		res = pe1.setbold(1)

		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		kod=CARI20T.KARSI_CODE(satirno)
		Qstr="SELECT * FROM BNK00C WHERE KOD='"&kod&"' AND VARSAYILAN='E'"
		Set BNK0C1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("123dfg",Qstr)
		if BNK0C1.getreccount>0 Then
			bankakodu = BNK0C1.BANKA_KODU(1)
			subekodu = BNK0C1.SUBE_KODU(1)
			hesapno = BNK0C1.HESAPNO(1)
     ibanno  = BNK0C1.IBAN(1)
  End if
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)



		If trim(CARI20T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		satiryuksekligi = 5
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
			End If
		End If		
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				select case degiskenadi
							Case  "KARSI_CODE"
								if trim(doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", kod, ""))="" then
									Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", kod, "")
								else
									Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", kod, "")
								end if
							Case  "KBANKA_ADI"
								Degisken = doc.getdbfieldvalue("BNK00", "AD", Bankakodu, "")
							Case  "KSUBENO"
								Degisken = subekodu
							Case  "KSUBE_ADI"
								Set BNK00t1 = Doc.Select1("ABCffxx","BNK00T","SUBE_KODU='"+subekodu+"'","",-1)
								for v=1 to bnk00t1.getreccount
									if trim(bnk00t1.KOD(v))=trim(bankakodu) then
										degisken=bnk00t1.SUBE_ADI(v)
									end if
								next
							Case  "KHESAPNO"
								Degisken = hesapno
                 Case "KIBAN"
                   Degisken = ibanno


				case else
					Degisken = trim(cstr(CARI20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				end select
				if degiskenadi="CH_ALACAKFIYAT" then
						Tutar=tutar+CARI20T.CH_ALACAKFIYAT(satirno)
						soltutar=sol
						solgen=sutungenisligi-2
				end if
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,6)
	Grid(0,0) = "KARSI_CODE"
	Grid(1,0) = "KBANKA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "KSUBE_ADI"
	Grid(3,0) = "KIBAN"
	Grid(4,0) = "CH_ALACAKFIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "CH_KUR"

	Grid(0,1) = 65
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 30
	Grid(3,1) = 50
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 12

	Grid(0,2) = "Hesap Adý"
	Grid(1,2) = "Banka Adý"
	Grid(2,2) = "Banka Þube"
	Grid(3,2) = "Iban No"
	Grid(4,2) = "Tutar"
	Grid(5,2) = ""

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"



	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = CARI20T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		'res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 10)
	If satirno = 16 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=131
	End If	

	satirpozr= satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 8
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left") 'eKLENDÝ

	stokkod=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	stokkodu = doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokKod,chkodu)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	if trim(stokkodu)= ""then
		'res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,30,4,37,stokkod)
	else
		'res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,30,4,37,stokkodu)
	end if
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	stokadi=trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","NAME2",stokkod,-1))

	if stokadi="" then stokadi=STOK46T.NONSTOK_AD(i)

	stokadi1=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",stokkod,-1) 

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,31,4,25,stokadi)
	'res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,50,4,25,stokadi1)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	miktar=STOK46T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
	birim=STOK46T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	parabirimi=STOK46T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,65,4,20,miktar)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,95,4,8,birim)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	fiyat=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK46T.OR_FIYAT(i),15,4)
'	isk= Doc.NumFormat0(STOK46T.ISKONTO_EFEKTIF(i),15,2)
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,125,4,29,fiyat& + " "& parabirimi)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,98,4,19,isk)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	testar=Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,170,4,23,testar)

End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, sayfaSatirSayisi, S60T

Sub PrintForm()
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("ssee7788", "STOK60T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRowCount()
		S60T.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(i) = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T", "CHSIPANO", S60T.SIPARTNO(i), "ARTNO")
	Next
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD+SEVKPAKETLOTNO")
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	siraNo = 0

	sayfaBoyu = 279.4
	sayfaEni = 215.9
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Irsaliye", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	ustmargin = -1 * satiryuksekligi
	satirBaslangic = ustmargin + 23 * satirYuksekligi
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 25
	solmargin = 5
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = S60T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	chkodu=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	Chadi2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",Chkodu,-1)
	adres1=	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
	adres2=	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
	adres3=	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
  irsno = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1) 


	VergiDairesi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", CHKodu, "")
	VergiNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", CHKodu, "")

	vergidairesi=STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGIDAIRESI(1)
	vergino=STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGINO(1)
	tarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	satirSayisi = S60T.GetRecCount()
	y=0
	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

  res=pe1.write(UstMargin +11 * satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 100, "Ýrsaliye No : "&irsno) 

	res=pe1.write(UstMargin + 13 * satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 100, chadi) 

	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 160, adres1)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 150, adres2)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 100, adres3)
	res=pe1.write(76, 37, 4, 70, vergidairesi)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, 94, 4, 50, vergino)
	res=pe1.write(54, 160,4, 20, tarih)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)

Dim satirpozr

		If trim(S60T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub

		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		If siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		stokkodu = S60T.KOD(satirno)						
		MStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)
		MStokAdi = Doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)
		SipNo = S60T.SIPNO(satirno)
		ArtNo = S60T.SIPARTNO(satirno)
		MSipANo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T", "CHSIPANO", ArtNo, "ARTNO")
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			AlanAdi = Grid(i,0)
			if AlanAdi = "_MSIPANO" Then
				Degisken = MSipANo
			Else
				Degisken = S60T.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi,SatirNo)
			end If

			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "_MSIPANO"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 20
	Grid(1,1) = 70
	Grid(2,1) = 23 
	Grid(3,1) = 15 
	Grid(4,1) = 40 
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, sayfaSatirSayisi, S60T
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, satirYuksekligi, SagMargin, solmargin, ustmargin, chkodu
Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("ssee7788", "STOK60T", "", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRowCount()
		S60T.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(i) = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T", "CHSIPANO", S60T.SIPARTNO(i), "ARTNO")
	Next
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD+SEVKPAKETLOTNO")
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	siraNo = 0

	sayfaBoyu = 279.4
	sayfaEni = 215.9
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Irsaliye", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	ustmargin = -1 * satiryuksekligi
	satirBaslangic = ustmargin + 23 * satirYuksekligi
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 25
	solmargin = 5
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = S60T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	chkodu=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	Chadi2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",Chkodu,-1)
	adres1=	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
	adres2=	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
	adres3=	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)

	VergiDairesi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", CHKodu, "")
	VergiNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", CHKodu, "")

	vergidairesi=STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGIDAIRESI(1)
	vergino=STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGINO(1)
	tarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	satirSayisi = S60T.GetRecCount()
	y=0
	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res=pe1.write(UstMargin + 13 * satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 100, chadi) 
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 160, adres1)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 150, adres2)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, 30, 4, 100, adres3)
	res=pe1.write(76, 37, 4, 70, vergidairesi)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, 94, 4, 50, vergino)
	res=pe1.write(54, 160,4, 20, tarih)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)

Dim satirpozr

		If trim(S60T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub

		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		If siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		stokkodu = S60T.KOD(satirno)						
		MStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)
		MStokAdi = Doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)
		SipNo = S60T.SIPNO(satirno)
		ArtNo = S60T.SIPARTNO(satirno)
		MSipANo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40T", "CHSIPANO", ArtNo, "ARTNO")
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			AlanAdi = Grid(i,0)
			if AlanAdi = "_MSIPANO" Then
				Degisken = MSipANo
			Else
				Degisken = S60T.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi,SatirNo)
			end If

			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
'	not1 = STOK60E.NOTES_1(1)
'	not2 = STOK60E.NOTES_2(1)
'	not3 = STOK60E.NOTES_3(1)
'	Sofor = STOK60E.BOX1_2
'	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(3,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "_MSIPANO"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 93 
	Grid(2,1) = 15 
	Grid(3,1) = 40 
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : CAVO_2016 / Uygulama : PFRM7S

Public Depo, StokTipi, Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo
Sub PrintLabel()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 6
	EtiketBoyu = 130
	EtiketEni = 198
	EtiketlerArasi = 145
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Cavo Sayým Etiketi",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	solMargin = 6
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 6


Stoktipi = InputBox("Stok Tipini Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - HAMMADDE "& Chr(13) & "B - MAMUL "& Chr(13) & "C - YARIMAMUL "& Chr(13) & "D - FASON "& Chr(13) & "E - TICARI", "Dinamo", "A")
if Stoktipi = "A" then st = "HAMMADDE" end if
if Stoktipi = "B" then st = "MAMUL" end if
if Stoktipi = "C" then st = "YARIMAMUL" end if
if Stoktipi = "D" then st = "FASON" end if
if Stoktipi = "E" then st = "TICARI" end if

Depo = InputBox("Sayým Etiketi Alýnacak Depoyu Giriniz", "Dinamo", "01MER")


if ((Stoktipi = "A") or (Stoktipi = "B") or (Stoktipi = "C") or (Stoktipi = "D") or (Stoktipi = "E")) and (Depo <> "") then 

    Set T_STOK00 = Doc.CreateRowSetObject("XXX=STOK00","REPORT") 
    Set Kriterler = Doc.CreateSObject("Query")
    Kriterler.UseTable "STOK00"
    k = T_STOK00.RunQuery(Kriterler)
    set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00","")

       satirSayisi = T_STOK00.GetRecCount()
         For ni = 1 to  satirSayisi 
          ToplamMiktar = Doc.Stok00c_SonMik(T_STOK00.KOD(ni),trim(Depo))                 
            IF (trim(T_STOK00.GK_1(ni))=TRIM(st) ) AND (ToplamMiktar>0) AND ( (trim(T_STOK00.KART_TIPI(ni))="U") OR (trim(T_STOK00.KART_TIPI(ni))="S"))  THEN                           
 			       EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			       if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
				      Ust = UstMargin
				      if EtiketNo <> 1 then
					     res = pe1.PageBreak()
				      end if
			       else
				     Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
			       end if
              CALL Etiket(pe1,T_STOK00.KOD(ni),trim(Depo))                 
            End if
         Next 
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End if
End Sub

Sub Etiket(pe1,xkod,xdepo)
	sol = solMargin
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Ust
  	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",14)
  	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
  	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
  	'res = pe1.Box(RusT,sol,12,113)		
	'res = pe1.Write(Rust,sol,10,100,trim(xkod))
	res = pe1.Barcode(Rust, sol,10,10 * iSatir,"CODE128",xkod,"")

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirNo)

	satirYuksekligi = 5
	iSatir = 7
	satirSonu = 272
	
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(satirNo)

	If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
		sayi=sayi+1
		'if sayi <> 1 then
		'	res=pe1.pagebreak
		'	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		'end if

'Sýra numaralarý sorgulanýyor.
   	rSiraNo = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo))
   	For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j))
			KaynakTipi1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j))
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				n=n+1
			End If
		Next

'****************************
		
		'sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10*iSatir
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 4*iSatir


		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			 siraNo = 1
			 res = pe1.PageBreak()
			 'satirpozr = 90
				Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = 50

		Else
			 If satirNo = 1 Or OperasyonSatirNo = 0 Then
				  satirpozr = 50
					'satirpozr = 25
			 Else
				  satirpozr = pe1.GetBottom() + satiryuksekligi+10
			 End If
			 siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
			
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)

					 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					 'satirpozr = 92
						satirpozr = 50
					 BaslikBasla = 52
					 HSatirBaslangic = 52
					 k = 0
				End If
				res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
				If (k Mod 2) = 0 Then
					res = pe1.NoPen()					
					res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
    				res = pe1.Box(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir - 1,10,6,190)
				End If
				res = pe1.UseSet(1)

				res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",8)
				HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(j)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,12,6,35,HammaddeKodu)

				HammaddeAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,35,6,100,HammaddeAdi)

				HammaddeMiktar = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				ondalik = doc.sigdig(MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j))
				'res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,123,6,20,doc.numformat(HammaddeMiktar,12, 0))
				paketicerik=MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI
				birimm=Doc.div(Hammaddemiktar,paketicerik)
				res = pe1.Write(HsatirBaslangic+k*iSatir,88,6,35,doc.numformat(birimm,10,4))

				HammaddeBirim = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,145,6,8,HammaddeBirim)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,165,6,25,"------------")

				k = k + 1
			End If
		Next
		HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,HSatirSonu - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
		OperasyonSatirNo = OperasyonSatirNo + 1
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

		ustmargin=150
		solmargin=50

		res=pe1.Setbold(0)
		res =pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)

		res = pe1.Line(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir+2,10,0,150)

		
	End If 
End Sub


Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)	
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,MMPS10T.maxSigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,100,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")
	 		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,105,6,35,HammaddeMiktari)

		End If
	
	Next
	
End Sub

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

   CALL SAYFA(PE1)             
 res = pe1.Show()
 res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Public Depo, StokTipi, Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo
Sub PrintLabel()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 6
	EtiketBoyu = 130
	EtiketEni = 198
	EtiketlerArasi = 145
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Cavo Sayým Etiketi",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	solMargin = 6
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 6


Stoktipi = InputBox("Stok Tipini veya Stok Kodunu Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - HAMMADDE "& Chr(13) & "B - MAMUL "& Chr(13) & "C - YARIMAMUL "& Chr(13) & "D - FASON "& Chr(13) & "E - TICARI "& Chr(13) & "F - BAKIM MLZ "& Chr(13) & "G - MONTAJYM0 ", "Dinamo", "A")

Stoktipi = UCase(StokTipi)

if Stoktipi = "A" then st = "HAMMADDE" end if
if Stoktipi = "B" then st = "MAMUL" end if
if Stoktipi = "C" then st = "YARIMAMUL" end if
if Stoktipi = "D" then st = "FASON" end if
if Stoktipi = "E" then st = "TICARI" end if
if Stoktipi = "F" then st = "BAKIMMLZ" end if
if Stoktipi = "F" then st = "MONTAJYM0" end if



if len(Stoktipi) > 1 then st = trim(Stoktipi)


Depo = InputBox("Sayým Etiketi Alýnacak Depo Kodunu Giriniz", "Dinamo", "01MER")
Depo = UCase(Depo)

if ((Stoktipi = "A") or (Stoktipi = "B") or (Stoktipi = "C") or (Stoktipi = "D") or (Stoktipi = "E") or (Stoktipi = "F") or (Stoktipi = "G")) and (Depo <> "") then 

    Set T_STOK00 = Doc.CreateRowSetObject("XXX=STOK00","REPORT") 
    Set Kriterler = Doc.CreateSObject("Query")
    Kriterler.UseTable "STOK00"
    k = T_STOK00.RunQuery(Kriterler)
    set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00","")

       satirSayisi = T_STOK00.GetRecCount()
       EtiketNo = 0
         For ni = 1 to  satirSayisi 
          ToplamMiktar = Doc.Stok00c_SonMik(T_STOK00.KOD(ni),trim(Depo))                 
            IF (trim(T_STOK00.GK_1(ni))=TRIM(st) ) AND (ToplamMiktar>0) AND ( (trim(T_STOK00.KART_TIPI(ni))="U") OR (trim(T_STOK00.KART_TIPI(ni))="S"))  THEN                           
 			       EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			       if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
				      Ust = UstMargin

	 res = pe1.Show()
	 Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
 else
  MsgBox("Seçenekleri doðru doldurunuz...")
 end if

End if
End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()

End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 6
	EtiketBoyu = 130
	EtiketEni = 198
	EtiketlerArasi = 145
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Cavo Sayým Etiketi",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	solMargin = 6
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 6


Stoktipi = InputBox("Stok Tipini veya Stok Kodunu Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - HAMMADDE "& Chr(13) & "B - MAMUL "& Chr(13) & "C - YARIMAMUL "& Chr(13) & "D - FASON "& Chr(13) & "E - TICARI", "Dinamo", "A")

Stoktipi = UCase(StokTipi)

if Stoktipi = "A" then st = "HAMMADDE" end if
if Stoktipi = "B" then st = "MAMUL" end if
if Stoktipi = "C" then st = "YARIMAMUL" end if
if Stoktipi = "D" then st = "FASON" end if
if Stoktipi = "E" then st = "TICARI" end if
if len(Stoktipi) > 1 then st = trim(Stoktipi)


Depo = InputBox("Sayým Etiketi Alýnacak Depo Kodunu Giriniz", "Dinamo", "01MER")
Depo = UCase(Depo)

if ((Stoktipi = "A") or (Stoktipi = "B") or (Stoktipi = "C") or (Stoktipi = "D") or (Stoktipi = "E")) and (Depo <> "") then 

    Set T_STOK00 = Doc.CreateRowSetObject("XXX=STOK00","REPORT") 
    Set Kriterler = Doc.CreateSObject("Query")
    Kriterler.UseTable "STOK00"
    k = T_STOK00.RunQuery(Kriterler)
    set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00","")

       satirSayisi = T_STOK00.GetRecCount()
       EtiketNo = 0
         For ni = 1 to  satirSayisi 
          ToplamMiktar = Doc.Stok00c_SonMik(T_STOK00.KOD(ni),trim(Depo))                 
            IF (trim(T_STOK00.GK_1(ni))=TRIM(st) ) AND (ToplamMiktar>0) AND ( (trim(T_STOK00.KART_TIPI(ni))="U") OR (trim(T_STOK00.KART_TIPI(ni))="S"))  THEN                           
 			       EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			       if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
				      Ust = UstMargin
				      if EtiketNo <> 1 then
					     res = pe1.PageBreak()
				      end if
			       else
				     Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
			       end if
              retiket = cstr(EtiketNo) 
              CALL Etiket(pe1,T_STOK00.KOD(ni),trim(Depo),Cstr(Etiketno),trim(st))                 
            End if
         Next 
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
else
 if (len(st) > 1) and (Depo <> "") then
   CALL Etiket(pe1,trim(st),trim(Depo),trim(st)&"-1","Tek")
	 res = pe1.Show()
	 Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
 else
  MsgBox("Seçenekleri doðru doldurunuz...")
 end if

End if
End Sub

  res = pe1.Write(68,8,4,42,PORTFOYKOD)

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

 	'res = pe1.Box(66,8,10,197)
