Sub PrintLabel()
	FirmaAdi = "MAGAL CAVO A.Þ"
	FirmaKodu = "GLCRB"

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 5
	EtiketBoyu = 140
	EtiketEni = 198
	EtiketlerArasi = 148
	solMargin = 6
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 6

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO), sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(0)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoChecksum(1)


	
	Set MainTableT = Doc.Select2g("asda", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "","KOD", -1)
'	MainTableT.GroupBy("BRUTAGIRLIK")


	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("S60T1251", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	for i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
		DockKodu = GetDockKodu(S60T.KOD(i), STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE, STOK60E.TARIH)
		CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
		CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
		KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		if trim(KonteynerKodu) = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
		KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_7",StokKodu,"")
		KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
		if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " sandýk içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	if trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" then
		k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","Freedom",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	

	
	For i = 2 to 2'MainTableT.GetRecCount()
			Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
			KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_7",MainTableT.KOD(i),"")
			KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
			if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
				EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
			end if
			
			for t = 1 To EtiketAdedi	
				
				for k = 1 to 2 'her etiketten 2 tane
					EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
					if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
						Ust = UstMargin
						if EtiketNo <> 1 then
							res = pe1.PageBreak()
						end if
					else
						Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
					end if
					Call Etiket(pe1,i,KutuIciMiktar)
				next
			next 	
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

'?M or 4S - Unique Serial Number - Master Label 
'5S -Unique Serial Number - Mixed Label 
'G - Unique Serial Number - Mixed Load ILVS (in line vehicle sequencing) 
'D - Date 
'1T - Lot/Batch number 
'L - Storage Location 
'?N - Delivery Document/ASN Number 
'1L - Dock Code 
'20L - Line Feed Location

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Function GetNetAgirlik(satirNo)
	StokKodu = MainTableT.KOD(satirNo)
	NetAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_4",StokKodu,"") * MainTableT.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	GetNetAgirlik = Doc.Round(NetAgirlik, 0)
End Function
Function GetBrutAgirlik(satirNo)
	NetAgirlik = GetNetAgirlik(satirNo)
	KasaAgirligi = GetKasaAgirligi(satirNo)
	GetBrutAgirlik = NetAgirlik + KasaAgirligi
End Function
Function GetKasaAgirligi(satirNo)
	StokKodu = MainTableT.KOD(satirNo)
	KasaAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_5",StokKodu,"")
	GetKasaAgirligi = Doc.Round(KasaAgirligi, 0)
End Function


Function GetKasaInfo(StokKodu, CHKodu)
	Dim KasaArray(1)
	KasaArray(0) = ""
	KasaArray(1) = 0

	QStr = "EVRAKNO='"+StokKodu
	if trim(CHKodu) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr + "'&CH_KODU='"+trim(CHKodu)
	End if
	QStr = QStr + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QStr, "", -1)
	if S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", "EVRAKNO='"+StokKodu+"'&VARSAYILAN='E'", "", -1)
	End if
	
	KasaArray(0)=S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1)
	KasaArray(1)=S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
	GetKasaInfo = KasaArray

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"
End Function


Function StringToHex(ByRef pstrString)
	Dim llngIndex
	Dim llngMaxIndex
	Dim lstrHex
	llngMaxIndex = Len(pstrString)
	For llngIndex = 1 To llngMaxIndex
		lstrHex = lstrHex & Right("0" & Hex(Asc(Mid(pstrString, llngIndex, 1))), 2)
	Next
	StringToHex = lstrHex
End Function

Function HexToString(ByRef pstrHex)
	Dim llngIndex
	Dim llngMaxIndex
	Dim lstrString
	llngMaxIndex = Len(pstrHex)
	For llngIndex = 1 To llngMaxIndex Step 2
		lstrString = lstrString & Chr("&h" & Mid(pstrHex, llngIndex, 2))
	Next
	HexToString = lstrString
End Function
Function GetDockKodu(StokKodu, SevkAdresKodu, SevkTarihi)
	QStr = "SELECT DOK FROM TNT00T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE KOD='" & StokKodu & "' AND TESLIM='" & Doc.LeftJustify(trim(SevkAdresKodu), 16) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND YUKLEMETARIHI='" & SevkTarihi & "'"

	Set T00T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dgaerhqeha", QStr)
	if T00T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		GetDockKodu = T00T.DOK(1)
	End if
End Function

Sub PrintLabel()
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) = "D1D4F" Then
		QStr = "SELECT KOD, SEVK_EDILEN_FB, LOKASYON FROM OTOSP1L" 
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
		QStr = QStr & " AND MUSTERIKODU='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH='" & STOK60E.TARIH & "'"

		Set OSP1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

		if OSP1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			QStr = "SELECT KOD, SEVK_EDILEN_FB, LOKASYON FROM OTOSP1L" 
			QStr = QStr & " WHERE SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
			QStr = QStr & " AND MUSTERIKODU='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
			QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH='" & Doc.StrDate_Increment(STOK60E.TARIH,-1) & "'"

			Set OSP1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

			if OSP1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
				k = Doc.d7msgBox("Gölcük etiket iþlemleri için sevkiyat günü FOSN programý alýnmýþ olmaldýr.","dinamo",MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			End if
		End if
	End if

	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)
	IrsSiraNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_NO", 0)
	if trim(IrsSeriNo) = "" or trim(IrsSiraNo) = "" Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "KTA 'daki Magal Ýrsaliye Seri ve Sýra No 'larý doldurulmalýdýr", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if

	if trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU) = "120 20 ZM0004F" Then
		UreticiKodu = "GLCRB"
	elseif trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU) = "120 20 ZM0004IHE" Then
		UreticiKodu = "GNGMA"
	Else
		UreticiKodu = "GLCRA"
	End if
	Unvan = "MAGAL CAVO OTOMOTIV TIC. SAN."
	Adres = "TOSB 1. CAD. 15. SOK. NO:3 ÇAYIROVA KOCAELI 41"
	Grade = ""

	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("S60T1251", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
		DockKodu = GetDockKodu(S60T.KOD(i), STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE, STOK60E.TARIH)
		CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
		CHStokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))
		SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
		
		If trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" Then
			k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","Freedom",MB_OK)
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		
		Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE EVRAKNO='" & StokKodu & "'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND CH_KODU='" & CHKodu & "'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND SHIPTOCODE = '" & SevkAdresKodu & "'"
		Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVCC45GG", Qstr) 

		If S0A.GetRowCount > 0 Then
			KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
			KonteynerKodu = S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1)
			KonteynerKoduAdi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
			If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
				KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
			End If
		Else
			KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_12",StokKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		End If
			
		KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
		
		If KonteynerKodu = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
		
		If KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
'			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " palet içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	
	Set S0A = Nothing
	
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 18
	EtiketBoyu = 117
	EtiketEni = 171
	EtiketlerArasi = 143
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 9
	CHKodu = Trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU)
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		Lokasyon = GetFordLokasyon(S60T.KOD(i))
		Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
		StokKodu = Trim(S60T.KOD(i))
		
		If StokKodu <> "" AND Miktar > 0 Then
			
			CHStokKodu = Trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))

			Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
			Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&StokKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(CH_KODU) = '"&CHKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(SHIPTOCODE) = '"&SevkAdresKodu&"' "
			Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVC4444C45GG", Qstr) 

			If S0A.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
				KonteynerKoduAdi = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,""))
				KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
				If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
					KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
				End If
			Else
				KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_12",StokKodu,"")
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
			End If
			if KutuIciMiktar > 0 Then
				KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
				
				if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
					EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
				Else
					EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
				end if
				for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
					Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
					if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
						KutuMiktari = Kalan
					else
						KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
					end if
					for k = 1 to 1 'her etiketten 2 tane
						EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
						if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
							Ust = UstMargin
							if EtiketNo <> 1 then
								res = pe1.PageBreak()
							end if
						else
							Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
						end if
						Call Etiket(pe1,i, KutuMiktari)
					next
					'EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				Next
			End if
		End if
	Next
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S60T1251"
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo, KutuMiktari)

	'res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,0,0))

	StokKodu = S60T.KOD(satirNo)
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
	Kapi = DockKodu	
	
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 120)

	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(120,120,120))
	res = pe1.Write(Ust + 25, solMargin, 80, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(solSag))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)

	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 75
	D2 = SolMargin + 143
	D3 = SolMargin + 100
	D4 = SolMargin + 113

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Y0 = Ust 
	Y1 = Ust + 17  '  Tedarikçi Bilgileri
	Y2 = Y1 + 34   ' Miktar ve Aðýrlýk Bilgisi
	Y3 = Y2 + 34	'  Kod Bilgisi
	Y4 = Y3 + 17	' Storage / Market Location,  Line Feed or ASN info
	Y5 = Y4 + 34	' Tedarikçi Kodu, serino,  Müþteri sevk adresi ve kodu
	Y6 = Y5 + 5 

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	'res = pe1.Box(Ust, SolMargin, Y6 - Ust, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin -D1)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, D1, Y2 - Y1, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, D3, Y4 - Y3, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, D4, Y5 - Y4, 0)

	sol = solmargin + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y0
	
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	sol2 = Sol + 65

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst , sol ,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"SUPP(V)")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sol1+2 , 8, sag - sol, Unvan)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",32)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst +3 , sol2 , 24  ,sag - sol2 , UreticiKodu)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(UreticiKodu)
	res=pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+3,sol1,10,BarkodGen, "CODE128", "V" & UreticiKodu,"")

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = D1
	rUst = Y1

	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst , sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"QTY (Q)")
	
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 48)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(KutuMiktari)
		
		res = pe1.Write(rUst-2, sol1+BarkodGen+2, 24, sag - sol1 - BarkodGen, KutuMiktari)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+18, sol+12, 10, BarkodGen, "CODE128", "Q" & KutuMiktari & "","")
	End if

	sol = D1 + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y1 + 1
	rUst1 = rUst+10
	rUst2 = rUst+20
	Sol1 = Sol+10
	Sol2 = Sol +30 

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sol, 6, sag - sol, "CONTAINER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 2, sol, 8, Sol2, KonteynerKodu)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "GROSS WGT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	'KonteynerAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_AGIRLIK", KonteynerKodu, "")
	'NetAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_AGIRLIK",StokKodu,"")	* KutuMiktari
	'BrutAgirlik = NetAgirlik + KonteynerAgirligi

	PaletBrutAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_9",StokKodu,"")	
	
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 + 2, sol, 8, sol2, Doc.NumFormat(PaletBrutAgirligi,15,0))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 + 6, sol+14, 8, 6, " KG")
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst2+1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "DATE")

	UrtAy= Doc.StrDate_Month(STOK60E.TARIH)

	Select Case UrtAy
		Case "1"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JAN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "2"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "FEB" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "3"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "4"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "APR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "5"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "6"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JUN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "7"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JLY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)				
		Case "8"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "AUG" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "9"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "SEP" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "10"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "OCT" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "11"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "NOV" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "12"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "DEC" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case Else
			UrtTarih= Left (UrtTarih,3) & "MMM" & Right(UrtTarih,2)	 
	End Select
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1, sol2,6,sag - sol2 ,"LOT/BATCH")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	PartiNo=S60T.LOTNUMBER(SatirNo)	
	
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 +3, sol2,10,sag - sol2, PartiNo)
	if Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",20)
		res = pe1.Write(rUst2+3 , sol, 10, sag - sol,UrtTarih )
	End if

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y2
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"PART (P)")
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",48)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		'sKod = replace(trim(CHStokKodu)," ","-") '18.03.2015 Ford Barkot þikayeti üzerinde
		sKod=trim(CHStokKodu)
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(sKod)
	
		res = pe1.Write(rUst - 2, sol1 + 10,25,sag - sol1 - 10,sKod)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+16,sol1,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","P" & sKod & "","")
	End if


	sol = SolMargin
	sag = SagMargin
	rUst = Y3 + 1
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"STR LOC 1")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",28)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+4, sol + 2,28,sag - sol, "AAAAA")


	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)
	IrsSiraNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_NO", 0)
	'IrsaliyeNo = "A-" & right("0" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),6)
	IrsaliyeNo = trim(IrsSeriNo) & "-" & trim(IrsSiraNo)

	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi("N" & IrsaliyeNo)

	sol = D3
	sag = SagMargin
	rUst = Y3 + 1
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"DELIVERY DOC/ASN NUMBER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",32)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+4, sol ,16,50,IrsaliyeNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+9, sol + 51, 5, BarkodGen-20, "CODE128","N" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "","")


	sol = SolMargin
	sag = D4
	rUst = Y4

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)

	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",14)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1, sol + 1,10,sag - sol - 1, StokKodu)
		ParcaAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,"")
		res = pe1.Write(rUst + 7, sol + 1,10,sag - sol - 1, ParcaAdi)
	End if
	
	SeriNo = UreticiKodu & EtiketNo
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(SeriNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+16, sol + 3,6,20,"SERIAL NO (S)")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+14, sol + 25,14,sag - sol-30, SeriNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+22,sol+12,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","S" & SeriNo,"")

	sol = D4 + 1
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y4 + 1
	
	If Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		Alici1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1
		Alici=STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	 	AliciAD=STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	Else
		Alici1 = "FORD MOTOR CO."
	End if	
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, Sol + 2.5 ,6,6,"TO")  'LOC+11
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst +3, Sol + 1,6,70, trim(AliciAd))

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sagmargin-12,6,12,"DOCK CODE") 		'LOC+159

	DockCode = Trim(DockKodu)
	if trim(DockCode) = "" Then DockCode = "26"

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 54)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+10, sol+42, 22, sag-sol-42, DockCode)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 17, sol+2 , 6, 10, "CUST")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 24)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+19 , sol+2 , 12, 35, trim(Alici))


	
'The following identifier codes are assigned for the different types of data: 
'P - Part Number, Prefix and Base 
'C - Part Number Suffix - NOTE: No longer used in this specification 
'Q - Quantity 
'V - Supplier Number 
'?S or 3S - Unique Serial Number - Shipping / Parts Identification Label 
'?M or 4S - Unique Serial Number - Master Label 
'5S -Unique Serial Number - Mixed Label 
'G - Unique Serial Number - Mixed Load ILVS (in line vehicle sequencing) 
'D - Date 
'1T - Lot/Batch number 
'L - Storage Location 
'?N - Delivery Document/ASN Number 
'1L - Dock Code 
'20L - Line Feed Location 
'The 18D will not be used at this time.(18D - "Global Date" may be the future DI for bar code use.) 
'8V- Customer ID 
'1P - Supplier Part Number 
'15D - Expiration Date 


'****************************
'Buraya kare kod yazýlacak
	sol = D2
	sag = SagMArgin
	rUst = Y0
	'GroupSpr="GS"
	GroupSpr= CHR(29)
	BarStr= "[)>"&CHR(30) &"06"
	UrtTarih1= Replace(Mid(STOK60E.TARIH, 3),"/","")
		
	BarStr= BarStr & GroupSpr&  "P" & trim(CHStokKodu) & GroupSpr& "Q"&PaletMiktari & GroupSpr& "V"& FirmaKodu 
	BarStr= BarStr &  GroupSpr &"D" & UrtTarih1 &  GroupSpr & "S"& trim(SeriNo) & GroupSpr & "N"&trim(IrsaliyeNo)& GroupSpr &"1T"&trim(PartiNo)
	'BarStr= BarStr & GroupSpr & "L"&trim(StorageLocation) & GroupSpr & "1L"& trim(DockCode)
	BarStr= BarStr & CHR(30) & Chr(4)

	res=pe1.PDF417(rUst, sol-10,40,60,BarStr)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
	GetFordLokasyon = ""
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) <> "D1D4F" Then Exit Function

	QStr = "KOD='" & StokKodu & "'&SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
	Set OSP1L = Doc.Select2("XZZXX", OSP1.GetAppName, QStr, "", -1)
	if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
		GetFordLokasyon = ""
	Else
		GetFordLokasyon = OSP1L.LOKASYON(1)
	End if
	Doc.DeletetableObject "XZZXX"
End Function
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetDockKodu(StokKodu, SevkAdresKodu, SevkTarihi)
	QStr = "SELECT DOK FROM TNT00T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE KOD='" & StokKodu & "' AND TESLIM='" & Doc.LeftJustify(trim(SevkAdresKodu), 16) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND YUKLEMETARIHI='" & SevkTarihi & "'"

	Set T00T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dgaerhqeha", QStr)
	if T00T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		GetDockKodu = T00T.DOK(1)
	End if
End Function

'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintLabel()
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) = "D1D4F" Then
		QStr = "SELECT KOD, SEVK_EDILEN_FB, LOKASYON FROM OTOSP1L" 
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
		QStr = QStr & " AND MUSTERIKODU='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH='" & STOK60E.TARIH & "'"

		Set OSP1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

		if OSP1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			QStr = "SELECT KOD, SEVK_EDILEN_FB, LOKASYON FROM OTOSP1L" 
			QStr = QStr & " WHERE SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
			QStr = QStr & " AND MUSTERIKODU='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
			QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH='" & Doc.StrDate_Increment(STOK60E.TARIH,-1) & "'"

			Set OSP1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

			if OSP1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
				k = Doc.d7msgBox("Gölcük etiket iþlemleri için sevkiyat günü FOSN programý alýnmýþ olmaldýr.","dinamo",MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			End if
		End if
	End if

	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)
	IrsSiraNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_NO", 0)
	if trim(IrsSeriNo) = "" or trim(IrsSiraNo) = "" Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "KTA 'daki Magal Ýrsaliye Seri ve Sýra No 'larý doldurulmalýdýr", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if

	if trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU) = "120 20 ZM0004F" Then
		UreticiKodu = "GLCRB"
	elseif trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU) = "120 20 ZM0004IHE" Then
		UreticiKodu = "GNGMA"
	Else
		UreticiKodu = "GLCRA"
	End if
	Unvan = "MAGAL CAVO OTOMOTIV TIC. SAN."
	Adres = "TOSB 1. CAD. 15. SOK. NO:3 ÇAYIROVA KOCAELI 41"
	Grade = ""

	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("S60T1251", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
		DockKodu = GetDockKodu(S60T.KOD(i), STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE, STOK60E.TARIH)
		CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
		CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
		SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
		
		If trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" Then
			k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","Freedom",MB_OK)
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		
		Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE EVRAKNO='" & StokKodu & "'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND CH_KODU='" & CHKodu & "'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND SHIPTOCODE = '" & SevkAdresKodu & "'"
		Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVCC45GG", Qstr) 

		If S0A.GetRowCount > 0 Then
			KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
			KonteynerKodu = S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1)
			KonteynerKoduAdi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
			If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
				KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
			End If
		Else
			KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_12",StokKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		End If
			
		KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
		
		If KonteynerKodu = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
		
		If KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
			'Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " pal içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	
	Set S0A = Nothing
	
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 18
	EtiketBoyu = 117
	EtiketEni = 171
	EtiketlerArasi = 143
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 9
	CHKodu = Trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU)
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		Lokasyon = GetFordLokasyon(S60T.KOD(i))
		Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
		StokKodu = Trim(S60T.KOD(i))
		
		If StokKodu <> "" AND Miktar > 0 Then
			
			CHStokKodu = Trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))

			Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
			Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&StokKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(CH_KODU) = '"&CHKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(SHIPTOCODE) = '"&SevkAdresKodu&"' "
			Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVC4444C45GG", Qstr) 

			If S0A.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
				KonteynerKoduAdi = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,""))
				KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
				If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
					KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
				End If
			Else
				KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_12",StokKodu,"")
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
			End If
			
			if KutuIciMiktar > 0 Then
				KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
				
				if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
					EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
				Else
					EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
				end if
				for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
					Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
					if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
						KutuMiktari = Kalan
					else
						KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
					end if
'					for k = 1 to 2 'her etiketten 2 tane
						EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
						if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
							Ust = UstMargin
							if EtiketNo <> 1 then
								res = pe1.PageBreak()
							end if
						else
							Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
						end if
						Call Etiket(pe1,i, KutuMiktari)
					next
					'EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				Next
			End if
		End if
	Next
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S60T1251"
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo, KutuMiktari)

	'res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,0,0))

	StokKodu = S60T.KOD(satirNo)
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
	Kapi = DockKodu	
	
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 120)

	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(120,120,120))
	res = pe1.Write(Ust + 25, solMargin, 80, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(solSag))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)

	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 75
	D2 = SolMargin + 143
	D3 = SolMargin + 100
	D4 = SolMargin + 113

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Y0 = Ust 
	Y1 = Ust + 17  '  Tedarikçi Bilgileri
	Y2 = Y1 + 34   ' Miktar ve Aðýrlýk Bilgisi
	Y3 = Y2 + 34	'  Kod Bilgisi
	Y4 = Y3 + 17	' Storage / Market Location,  Line Feed or ASN info
	Y5 = Y4 + 34	' Tedarikçi Kodu, serino,  Müþteri sevk adresi ve kodu
	Y6 = Y5 + 5 

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	'res = pe1.Box(Ust, SolMargin, Y6 - Ust, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin -D1)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, D1, Y2 - Y1, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, D3, Y4 - Y3, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, D4, Y5 - Y4, 0)

	sol = solmargin + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y0
	
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	sol2 = Sol + 65

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst , sol ,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"SUPP(V)")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sol1+2 , 8, sag - sol, Unvan)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",32)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst +3 , sol2 , 24  ,sag - sol2 , UreticiKodu)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(UreticiKodu)
	res=pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+3,sol1,10,BarkodGen, "CODE128", "V" & UreticiKodu,"")

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = D1
	rUst = Y1

	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst , sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"QTY (Q)")
	
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 48)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(KutuMiktari)
		
		res = pe1.Write(rUst-2, sol1+BarkodGen+2, 24, sag - sol1 - BarkodGen, KutuMiktari)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+18, sol+12, 10, BarkodGen, "CODE128", "Q" & KutuMiktari & "","")
	End if

	sol = D1 + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y1 + 1
	rUst1 = rUst+10
	rUst2 = rUst+20
	Sol1 = Sol+10
	Sol2 = Sol +30 

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sol, 6, sag - sol, "CONTAINER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 2, sol, 8, Sol2, KonteynerKodu)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "GROSS WGT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	'KonteynerAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_AGIRLIK", KonteynerKodu, "")
	'NetAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_AGIRLIK",StokKodu,"")	* KutuMiktari
	'BrutAgirlik = NetAgirlik + KonteynerAgirligi

	PaletBrutAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_9",StokKodu,"")	
	
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 + 2, sol, 8, sol2, Doc.NumFormat(PaletBrutAgirligi,15,0))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 + 6, sol+14, 8, 6, " KG")
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst2+1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "DATE")

	UrtAy= Doc.StrDate_Month(STOK60E.TARIH)

	Select Case UrtAy
		Case "1"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JAN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "2"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "FEB" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "3"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "4"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "APR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "5"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "6"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JUN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "7"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JLY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)				
		Case "8"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "AUG" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "9"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "SEP" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "10"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "OCT" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "11"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "NOV" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "12"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "DEC" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case Else
			UrtTarih= Left (UrtTarih,3) & "MMM" & Right(UrtTarih,2)	 
	End Select
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1, sol2,6,sag - sol2 ,"LOT/BATCH")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	PartiNo=S60T.LOTNUMBER(SatirNo)	
	
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 +3, sol2,10,sag - sol2, PartiNo)
	if Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",20)
		res = pe1.Write(rUst2+3 , sol, 10, sag - sol,UrtTarih )
	End if

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y2
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"PART (P)")
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",48)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		sKod = replace(trim(CHStokKodu)," ","-")
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(sKod)
	
		res = pe1.Write(rUst - 2, sol1 + 10,25,sag - sol1 - 10,sKod)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+16,sol1,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","P" & sKod & "","")
	End if


	sol = SolMargin
	sag = SagMargin
	rUst = Y3 + 1
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"STR LOC 1")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",28)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+4, sol + 2,28,sag - sol, "AAAAA")


	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)
	IrsSiraNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_NO", 0)
	'IrsaliyeNo = "A-" & right("0" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),6)
	IrsaliyeNo = trim(IrsSeriNo) & "-" & trim(IrsSiraNo)

	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi("N" & IrsaliyeNo)

	sol = D3
	sag = SagMargin
	rUst = Y3 + 1
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"DELIVERY DOC/ASN NUMBER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",32)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+4, sol ,16,50,IrsaliyeNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+9, sol + 51, 5, BarkodGen-20, "CODE128","N" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "","")


	sol = SolMargin
	sag = D4
	rUst = Y4

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)

	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",14)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1, sol + 1,10,sag - sol - 1, StokKodu)
		ParcaAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,"")
		res = pe1.Write(rUst + 7, sol + 1,10,sag - sol - 1, ParcaAdi)
	End if
	
	SeriNo = UreticiKodu & EtiketNo
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(SeriNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+16, sol + 3,6,20,"SERIAL NO (S)")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+14, sol + 25,14,sag - sol-30, SeriNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+22,sol+12,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","S" & SeriNo,"")

	sol = D4 + 1
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y4 + 1
	
	If Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		Alici1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1
		Alici=STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	 	AliciAD=STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	Else
		Alici1 = "FORD MOTOR CO."
	End if	
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, Sol + 2.5 ,6,6,"TO")  'LOC+11
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst +3, Sol + 1,6,70, trim(AliciAd))

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sagmargin-12,6,12,"DOCK CODE") 		'LOC+159

	DockCode = Trim(DockKodu)
	if trim(DockCode) = "" Then DockCode = "26"

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 54)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+10, sol+42, 22, sag-sol-42, DockCode)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 17, sol+2 , 6, 10, "CUST")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 24)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+19 , sol+2 , 12, 35, trim(Alici))


	
'The following identifier codes are assigned for the different types of data: 
'P - Part Number, Prefix and Base 
'C - Part Number Suffix - NOTE: No longer used in this specification 
'Q - Quantity 
'V - Supplier Number 
'?S or 3S - Unique Serial Number - Shipping / Parts Identification Label 
'?M or 4S - Unique Serial Number - Master Label 
'5S -Unique Serial Number - Mixed Label 
'G - Unique Serial Number - Mixed Load ILVS (in line vehicle sequencing) 
'D - Date 
'1T - Lot/Batch number 
'L - Storage Location 
'?N - Delivery Document/ASN Number 
'1L - Dock Code 
'20L - Line Feed Location 
'The 18D will not be used at this time.(18D - "Global Date" may be the future DI for bar code use.) 
'8V- Customer ID 
'1P - Supplier Part Number 
'15D - Expiration Date 


'****************************
'Buraya kare kod yazýlacak
	sol = D2
	sag = SagMArgin
	rUst = Y0
	'GroupSpr="GS"
	GroupSpr= CHR(29)
	BarStr= "[)>"&CHR(30) &"06"
	UrtTarih1= Replace(Mid(STOK60E.TARIH, 3),"/","")
		
	BarStr= BarStr & GroupSpr&  "P" & trim(CHStokKodu) & GroupSpr& "Q"&PaletMiktari & GroupSpr& "V"& FirmaKodu 
	BarStr= BarStr &  GroupSpr &"D" & UrtTarih1 &  GroupSpr & "S"& trim(SeriNo) & GroupSpr & "N"&trim(IrsaliyeNo)& GroupSpr &"1T"&trim(PartiNo)
	'BarStr= BarStr & GroupSpr & "L"&trim(StorageLocation) & GroupSpr & "1L"& trim(DockCode)
	BarStr= BarStr & CHR(30) & Chr(4)

	res=pe1.PDF417(rUst, sol-10,40,60,BarStr)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
	GetFordLokasyon = ""
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) <> "D1D4F" Then Exit Function

	QStr = "KOD='" & StokKodu & "'&SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
	Set OSP1L = Doc.Select2("XZZXX", OSP1.GetAppName, QStr, "", -1)
	if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
		GetFordLokasyon = ""
	Else
		GetFordLokasyon = OSP1L.LOKASYON(1)
	End if
	Doc.DeletetableObject "XZZXX"
End Function
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetDockKodu(StokKodu, SevkAdresKodu, SevkTarihi)
	QStr = "SELECT DOK FROM TNT00T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE KOD='" & StokKodu & "' AND TESLIM='" & Doc.LeftJustify(trim(SevkAdresKodu), 16) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND YUKLEMETARIHI='" & SevkTarihi & "'"

	Set T00T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dgaerhqeha", QStr)
	if T00T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		GetDockKodu = T00T.DOK(1)
	End if
End Function

Sub PrintLabel()
	FirmaAdi = "MAGAL CAVO A.Þ"
	FirmaKodu = "GLCRB"

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 105
	sayfaEni = 148
	Ustmargin = 4
	EtiketBoyu = 70
	EtiketEni = 110
	EtiketlerArasi = 105
	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 9

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO), sayfaEni, sayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(0)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoChecksum(1)

	UreticiKodu = "GLCRB"
	Unvan = "MAGAL CAVO OTOMOTIV TIC. SAN."
	Adres = "TOSB 1. CAD. 15. SOK. NO:3 ÇAYIROVA KOCAELI 41"
	Grade = ""

	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("S60T1251", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	
	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	if trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" then
		k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","Freedom",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if	
		
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = Trim(S60T.KOD(i))
		DockKodu = Trim(GetDockKodu(S60T.KOD(i), STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE, STOK60E.TARIH))
		CHKodu = Trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU)
		CHStokKodu = Trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))
		SevkAdresKodu = Trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)
		
		If SevkAdresKodu = "" Then
			k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","Freedom",MB_OK)
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		
		Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&StokKodu&"' "
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(CH_KODU) = '"&CHKodu&"' "
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(SHIPTOCODE) = '"&SevkAdresKodu&"' "
		Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVCC45GG", Qstr) 

		If S0A.GetRowCount > 0 Then
			KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
			KonteynerKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
			KonteynerKoduAdi = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,""))
			KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
			If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
			End If
		Else
			KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_7",StokKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
		End If
			
		KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
		
		If KonteynerKodu = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
		
		If KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " sandýk içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	
	Set S0A = Nothing
	
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
		StokKodu = Trim(S60T.KOD(i))
		Lokasyon = GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
			
		If StokKodu <> "" AND Miktar > 0 Then
			
			CHStokKodu = Trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))
			
			Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
			Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&StokKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(CH_KODU) = '"&CHKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(SHIPTOCODE) = '"&SevkAdresKodu&"' "
			Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVCC45GG", Qstr) 

			If S0A.GetRowCount > 0 Then
				KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
				KonteynerKoduAdi = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,""))
				KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
				
				If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
					KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
				End If
			Else
				KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_7",StokKodu,"")
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
			End If
	
			KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar, 0)
			
			If KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
				EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
			end if

			for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
				Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
				if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
					KutuMiktari = Kalan
				else
					KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
				end if
				
				For k = 1 to 2 'her etiketten 2 tane
					Ust = UstMargin
					Call Etiket(pe1, i, KutuMiktari)
					res = pe1.PageBreak
				next
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			Next	
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Etiket(pe1, satirNo, KutuMiktari)
	StokKodu = S60T.KOD(satirNo)
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	CHStokKodu = trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu, CHKodu))
	Kapi = DockKodu	
	
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)

	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(120,120,120))
	res = pe1.write(Ust + 25, solMargin, 80, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(solSag))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)

	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 55
	D2 = SolMargin + 105
	D3 = SolMargin + 65
	D4 = SolMargin + 75

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Y0 = Ust 
	Y1 = Ust + 14 '  Tedarikçi Bilgileri
	Y2 = Y1 + 23   ' Miktar ve Aðýrlýk Bilgisi
	Y3 = Y2 + 20	'  Kod Bilgisi
	Y4 = Y3 + 12	' Storage / Market Location,  Line Feed or ASN info
	Y5 = Y4 + 23	' Tedarikçi Kodu, serino,  Müþteri sevk adresi ve kodu
	Y6 = Y5  

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	'res = pe1.Box(Ust, SolMargin, Y6 - Ust, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, D1, Y2 - Y1, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, D3, Y4 - Y3, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, D4, Y5 - Y4, 0)

	sol = solmargin + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y0
	
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	sol2 = Sol + 65

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.write(rUst , sol ,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"SUPP(V)")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.write(rUst, sol1+2 , 8, sag - sol, Unvan)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",24)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(rUst +3 , sol2 , 24  ,sag - sol2 , UreticiKodu)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(UreticiKodu)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+3,sol1,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","V" & UreticiKodu,"")

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = D1
	rUst = Y1

	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.write(rUst , sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"QTY (Q)")
	
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",26)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(KutuMiktari)
		res = pe1.write(rUst-2, sol1+BarkodGen ,24, sag - sol1-BarkodGen , KutuMiktari)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+10,sol+12,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","Q" & KutuMiktari & "","")
	End if

	sol = D1 + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y1 + 1
	rUst1=rUst+7
	rUst2=rUst+14
	Sol1=Sol+6
	Sol2=Sol +20 

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst, sol, 6, sag - sol, "CONTAINER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst + 2, sol, 8, Sol2, KonteynerKodu)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "GROSS WGT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	'KonteynerAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_AGIRLIK", KonteynerKodu, "")
	'NetAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_AGIRLIK",StokKodu,"")	* KutuMiktari

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst2+1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "DATE")

	UrtAy= Doc.StrDate_Month(STOK60E.TARIH)

	Select Case UrtAy
		Case "1"

		Case "3"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "4"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "APR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "5"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "6"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JUN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "7"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JLY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)

			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "SEP" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "10"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "OCT" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "11"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "NOV" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "12"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "DEC" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case Else
			UrtTarih= Left (UrtTarih,3) & "MMM" & Right(UrtTarih,2)	 
	End Select
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	'res = pe1.writebox(rUst1, sol2,6,sag - sol2 ,"LOT/BATCH")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	'res = pe1.writebox(rUst1 +3, sol2,10,sag - sol2, PartiNo)
	
	If Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.writebox(rUst2+3 , sol, 10, sag-sol, UrtTarih)
	End if

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y2
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"PART (P)")
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",28)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		'sKod = replace(trim(CHStokKodu)," ","-") '18.03.2015 Ford Þikayeti üzerine kaldýrýldý

	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"STR LOC 1")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.writebox(rUst+4, sol + 2, 28, sag - sol, "AAAAA")

	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	sag = D4
	rUst = Y4

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Function GetNetAgirlik(satirNo)
	StokKodu = MainTableT.KOD(satirNo)
	NetAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_4",StokKodu,"") * MainTableT.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	GetNetAgirlik = Doc.Round(NetAgirlik, 0)
End Function
Function GetBrutAgirlik(satirNo)
	NetAgirlik = GetNetAgirlik(satirNo)
	KasaAgirligi = GetKasaAgirligi(satirNo)
	GetBrutAgirlik = NetAgirlik + KasaAgirligi
End Function
Function GetKasaAgirligi(satirNo)
	StokKodu = MainTableT.KOD(satirNo)
	KasaAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_5",StokKodu,"")
	GetKasaAgirligi = Doc.Round(KasaAgirligi, 0)
End Function


Function GetKasaInfo(StokKodu, CHKodu)
	Dim KasaArray(1)
	KasaArray(0) = ""
	KasaArray(1) = 0

	QStr = "EVRAKNO='"+StokKodu
	if trim(CHKodu) <> "" Then
		QStr = QStr + "'&CH_KODU='"+trim(CHKodu)
	End if
	QStr = QStr + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QStr, "", -1)
	if S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", "EVRAKNO='"+StokKodu+"'&VARSAYILAN='E'", "", -1)
	End if
	
	KasaArray(0)=S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1)
	KasaArray(1)=S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
	GetKasaInfo = KasaArray

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"
End Function


Function StringToHex(ByRef pstrString)
	Dim llngIndex
	Dim llngMaxIndex
	Dim lstrHex
	llngMaxIndex = Len(pstrString)
	For llngIndex = 1 To llngMaxIndex
		lstrHex = lstrHex & Right("0" & Hex(Asc(Mid(pstrString, llngIndex, 1))), 2)
	Next
	StringToHex = lstrHex
End Function

Function HexToString(ByRef pstrHex)
	Dim llngIndex
	Dim llngMaxIndex
	Dim lstrString
	llngMaxIndex = Len(pstrHex)
	For llngIndex = 1 To llngMaxIndex Step 2
		lstrString = lstrString & Chr("&h" & Mid(pstrHex, llngIndex, 2))
	Next
	HexToString = lstrString
End Function
Function GetDockKodu(StokKodu, SevkAdresKodu, SevkTarihi)
	QStr = "SELECT DOK FROM TNT00T"
	QStr = QStr & " WHERE KOD='" & StokKodu & "' AND TESLIM='" & Doc.LeftJustify(trim(SevkAdresKodu), 16) & "'"
	QStr = QStr & " AND YUKLEMETARIHI='" & SevkTarihi & "'"

	Set T00T = Doc.RunSQLQuery("dgaerhqeha", QStr)
	if T00T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		GetDockKodu = T00T.DOK(1)
	End if
End Function

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
	GetFordLokasyon = ""
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) <> "D1D4F" Then Exit Function

	QStr = "KOD='" & StokKodu & "'&SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
	Set OSP1L = Doc.Select2("XZZXX", OSP1.GetAppName, QStr, "", -1)
	if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
		GetFordLokasyon = ""
	Else
		GetFordLokasyon = OSP1L.LOKASYON(1)
	End if
	Doc.DeletetableObject "XZZXX"
End Function

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirNo)

	satirYuksekligi = 5
	iSatir = 7
	satirSonu = 272
	
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(satirNo)

	If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
		sayi=sayi+1
		'if sayi <> 1 then
		'	res=pe1.pagebreak
		'	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		'end if

'Sýra numaralarý sorgulanýyor.
   	rSiraNo = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo))
   	For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j))
			KaynakTipi1 = trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(j))
			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then
				n=n+1
			End If
		Next

'****************************
		
		'sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10*iSatir
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 4*iSatir


		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			 siraNo = 1
			 res = pe1.PageBreak()
			 'satirpozr = 90
				Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = 50

		Else
			 If satirNo = 1 Or OperasyonSatirNo = 0 Then
				  satirpozr = 50
					'satirpozr = 25
			 Else
				  satirpozr = pe1.GetBottom() + satiryuksekligi+10
			 End If
			 siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
			
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
		IsMerkeziAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",IsMerkeziKodu,-1)
		OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
		OperasyonAdi = doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
		MamulPaketSayisi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketSayisi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = MMPS10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(SatirNo)
		YariMamulPaketIcerigi = FormatNumber(YariMamulPaketIcerigi,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
		BaslamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MMPS10T.R_LATEST_B_TARIH(SatirNo))
		BitisTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(MMPS10T.R_LATEST_E_TARIH(SatirNo))

		sure=MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(SatirNo)
		if trim(MMPS10T.OPERATORSAYISI1(SatirNo))>0 then
			AdamSayisi= MMPS10T.OPERATORSAYISI1(SatirNo)
		else
			AdamSayisi=1
		end if
		ToplamAdamSaat= sure * AdamSayisi 
		ToplamAdamDakika= ToplamAdamSaat * 60
		Cevrim= DOC.DIV(sure * 3600 , ToplamYariMamulMiktari)
		ToplamAdamDakika = FormatNumber(ToplamAdamDakika,0,,,-1)
		ToplamYariMamulMiktari = FormatNumber(ToplamYariMamulMiktari,0,,,-1)

		
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
		m = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
		If m > 0 Then
			Boy = 3 * iSatir	+ 5
		Else
			Boy = 4 * iSatir - 2
		End If 
		
		BaslikBasla = SatirPozr - 3
		ToplamSatir = HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) 
		DisBoy = ToplamSatir + 3 * iSatir

		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
		
		res = pe1.NoPen()
'barkodun arka planý
		res = pe1.Box(satirPozr -3, 10,Boy,20)

		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)


		'res = pe1.SetRotation(270)
		ArtNo = MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)
		pe1.NoPen()

     If trim(KaynakTipi) = "I" Then
       'res=pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)

  		  'res = pe1.Barcode(satirPozr+22 ,12,15,7 * iSatir,"CODE128","%JB%" & trim(ArtNo),"")
     End If

		'res = pe1.SetRotation(0)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)

		'res = pe1.Line(satirpozr - iSatir+2,solmargin,0,150)
   	res = pe1.Write(satirpozr - iSatir+3,45,7,88,"/  Sýra No:"&rsiraNo)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,12,6,25,"Ýþ Merkezi ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,41,6,80,": " & trim(IsMerkeziKodu) & " - " & trim(IsMerkeziAdi))
		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,12,6,25,"Operasyon ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,41,6,60,": " & trim(OperasyonKodu) & " - " & trim(OperasyonAdi))

		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + iSatir,145,6,60,"Sonraki Operasyon:"&sonrakiOp)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,145,6,50,"Op.süresi:")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,165,6,20,": "& trim(sure))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr + 2*iSatir,12,6,25,"Üretim Miktarý ")

		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,100,6,15,"Çevrim")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,115,6,20, ": " & Doc.NumFormat(Cevrim,5,1) & " sn")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight + 1,6,10,"Setup")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop,pe1.GetRight + 1,6,20," : " & MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR1(SatirNo) * 60 & " dk")

		For j=1 To MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
			rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(j)

			If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And KaynakTipi1 = "H" Then

				If sonSatir1 >= satirSonu Then
			  		 res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,sonSatir1 - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
					 siraNo = 1

					 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)

				End If

					res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
    				res = pe1.Box(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir - 1,10,6,190)
				End If
				res = pe1.UseSet(1)

				res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",8)
				HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(j)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,12,6,35,HammaddeKodu)

				HammaddeAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)

				HammaddeMiktar = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j)

				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				ondalik = doc.sigdig(MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(j))
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,123,6,20,doc.numformat(HammaddeMiktar,12, 0))
				paketicerik=MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI
				birimm=Doc.div(Hammaddemiktar,paketicerik)
				res = pe1.Write(HsatirBaslangic+k*iSatir,88,6,35,doc.numformat(birimm,10,4))

				HammaddeBirim = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,145,6,8,HammaddeBirim)
				res = pe1.Write(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir,165,6,25,"------------")

				k = k + 1
			End If
		Next
		HSatirSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
		res = pe1.Box(BaslikBasla,10,HSatirSonu - BaslikBasla+3,190)						
		OperasyonSatirNo = OperasyonSatirNo + 1
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

		ustmargin=150
		solmargin=50

		res=pe1.Setbold(0)
		res =pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)

		res = pe1.Line(HSatirBaslangic + k*iSatir+2,10,0,150)

		
	End If 
End Sub


Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)	
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,MMPS10T.maxSigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,100,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")
	 		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,105,6,35,HammaddeMiktari)

		End If
	
	Next
	
End Sub

Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function

Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirYuksekligi = 7
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintLabel()
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) = "D1D4F" Then
		QStr = "SELECT KOD, SEVK_EDILEN_FB, LOKASYON FROM OTOSP1L" 
		QStr = QStr & " WHERE SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
		QStr = QStr & " AND MUSTERIKODU='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
		QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH='" & STOK60E.TARIH & "'"

		Set OSP1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

		if OSP1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			QStr = "SELECT KOD, SEVK_EDILEN_FB, LOKASYON FROM OTOSP1L" 
			QStr = QStr & " WHERE SEVK_EDILEN_FB='" & trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) & "'"
			QStr = QStr & " AND MUSTERIKODU='" & STOK60E.CH_KODU & "'"
			QStr = QStr & " AND TARIH='" & Doc.StrDate_Increment(STOK60E.TARIH,-1) & "'"

			Set OSP1 = Doc.RunSQLQuery("XXX", QStr)

			if OSP1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
				k = Doc.d7msgBox("Gölcük etiket iþlemleri için sevkiyat günü FOSN programý alýnmýþ olmaldýr.","dinamo",MB_OK)
				Exit Sub
			End if
		End if
	End if

	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)
	IrsSiraNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_NO", 0)
	if trim(IrsSeriNo) = "" or trim(IrsSiraNo) = "" Then
		Doc.d7MsgBox "KTA 'daki Magal Ýrsaliye Seri ve Sýra No 'larý doldurulmalýdýr", "Ýþlem Kesildi", MB_OK
		Exit Sub
	End if

	if trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU) = "120 20 ZM0004F" Then
		UreticiKodu = "GLCRB"
	elseif trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU) = "120 20 ZM0004IHE" Then
		UreticiKodu = "GNGMA"
	Else
		UreticiKodu = "GLCRA"
	End if
	Unvan = "MAGAL CAVO OTOMOTIV TIC. SAN."
	Adres = "TOSB 1. CAD. 15. SOK. NO:3 ÇAYIROVA KOCAELI 41"
	Grade = ""

	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("S60T1251", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
		DockKodu = GetDockKodu(S60T.KOD(i), STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE, STOK60E.TARIH)
		CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
		CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
		SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
		
		If trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" Then
			k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","Freedom",MB_OK)
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		
		Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE EVRAKNO='" & StokKodu & "'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND CH_KODU='" & CHKodu & "'"
		Qstr = Qstr &	" AND SHIPTOCODE = '" & SevkAdresKodu & "'"
		Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVCC45GG", Qstr) 

		If S0A.GetRowCount > 0 Then
			KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
			KonteynerKodu = S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1)
			KonteynerKoduAdi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
			If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
				KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
			End If
		Else
			KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_7",StokKodu,"")
			KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		End If
			
		KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
		
		If KonteynerKodu = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
		
		If KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " sandýk içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	
	Set S0A = Nothing
	
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 18
	EtiketBoyu = 117
	EtiketEni = 171
	EtiketlerArasi = 143
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 9
	CHKodu = Trim(STOK60E.CH_KODU)
	
	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		Lokasyon = GetFordLokasyon(S60T.KOD(i))
		Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
		StokKodu = Trim(S60T.KOD(i))
		
		If StokKodu <> "" AND Miktar > 0 Then
			
			CHStokKodu = Trim(Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu))

			Qstr = "SELECT * FROM STOK0A"
			Qstr = Qstr &	" WHERE  Trim(EVRAKNO) = '"&StokKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(CH_KODU) = '"&CHKodu&"' "
			Qstr = Qstr &	" AND  Trim(SHIPTOCODE) = '"&SevkAdresKodu&"' "
			Set S0A = Doc.RunSQLQuery("VVC4444C45GG", Qstr) 

			If S0A.GetRecCount > 0 Then
				KutuIciMiktar = S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1)
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
				KonteynerKoduAdi = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",KonteynerKodu,""))
				KonteynerKodu = Left(KonteynerKoduAdi, 7)
			
				If KonteynerKodu = "" Then 
					KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
				End If
			Else
				KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_7",StokKodu,"")
				KonteynerKodu = Trim(Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,""))
			End If
			
			KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)
			
			if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
				EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
			end if
			for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
				Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
				if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
					KutuMiktari = Kalan
				else
					KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
				end if
				for k = 1 to 1 'her etiketten 2 tane
					EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
					if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
						Ust = UstMargin
						if EtiketNo <> 1 then
							res = pe1.PageBreak()
						end if
					else
						Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
					end if
					Call Etiket(pe1,i, KutuMiktari)
				next
				'EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			Next
		End if
	Next
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S60T1251"
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo, KutuMiktari)

	'res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,0,0))

	StokKodu = S60T.KOD(satirNo)
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
	Kapi = DockKodu	
	
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 120)

	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(120,120,120))
	res = pe1.Write(Ust + 25, solMargin, 80, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(solSag))
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)

	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 75
	D2 = SolMargin + 143
	D3 = SolMargin + 100
	D4 = SolMargin + 113

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Y0 = Ust 
	Y1 = Ust + 17  '  Tedarikçi Bilgileri
	Y2 = Y1 + 34   ' Miktar ve Aðýrlýk Bilgisi
	Y3 = Y2 + 34	'  Kod Bilgisi
	Y4 = Y3 + 17	' Storage / Market Location,  Line Feed or ASN info
	Y5 = Y4 + 34	' Tedarikçi Kodu, serino,  Müþteri sevk adresi ve kodu
	Y6 = Y5 + 5 

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	'res = pe1.Box(Ust, SolMargin, Y6 - Ust, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin -D1)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5, SolMargin, 0, sagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.Line(Y1, D1, Y2 - Y1, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3, D3, Y4 - Y3, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4, D4, Y5 - Y4, 0)

	sol = solmargin + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y0
	
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	sol2 = Sol + 65

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst , sol ,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"SUPP(V)")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sol1+2 , 8, sag - sol, Unvan)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",32)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst +3 , sol2 , 24  ,sag - sol2 , UreticiKodu)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(UreticiKodu)
	res=pe1.SetBarcodeParms(2,2)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+3,sol1,10,BarkodGen, "CODE128", "V" & UreticiKodu,"")

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = D1
	rUst = Y1

	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst , sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"QTY (Q)")
	
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 48)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(KutuMiktari)
		
		res = pe1.Write(rUst-2, sol1+BarkodGen+2, 24, sag - sol1 - BarkodGen, KutuMiktari)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+18, sol+12, 10, BarkodGen, "CODE128", "Q" & KutuMiktari & "","")
	End if

	sol = D1 + 1
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y1 + 1
	rUst1 = rUst+10
	rUst2 = rUst+20
	Sol1 = Sol+10
	Sol2 = Sol +30 

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst, sol, 6, sag - sol, "CONTAINER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 2, sol, 8, Sol2, KonteynerKodu)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "GROSS WGT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	'KonteynerAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_AGIRLIK", KonteynerKodu, "")
	'NetAgirlik = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_AGIRLIK",StokKodu,"")	* KutuMiktari
	'BrutAgirlik = NetAgirlik + KonteynerAgirligi

	PaletBrutAgirligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_9",StokKodu,"")	
	
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 + 2, sol, 8, sol2, Doc.NumFormat(PaletBrutAgirligi,15,0))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 + 6, sol+14, 8, 6, " KG")
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst2+1, sol, 6, sag - sol, "DATE")

	UrtAy= Doc.StrDate_Month(STOK60E.TARIH)

	Select Case UrtAy
		Case "1"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JAN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "2"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "FEB" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "3"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	
		Case "4"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "APR" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "5"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "MAY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "6"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JUN" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case "7"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "JLY" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)				
		Case "8"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "AUG" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "9"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "SEP" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)	 
		Case "10"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "OCT" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "11"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "NOV" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
	  	Case "12"
			UrtTarih= Right(STOK60E.TARIH,2)	 & "DEC" & Left(STOK60E.TARIH,4)
		Case Else
			UrtTarih= Left (UrtTarih,3) & "MMM" & Right(UrtTarih,2)	 
	End Select
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1, sol2,6,sag - sol2 ,"LOT/BATCH")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	PartiNo=S60T.LOTNUMBER(SatirNo)	
	
	res = pe1.Write(rUst1 +3, sol2,10,sag - sol2, PartiNo)
	if Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",20)
		res = pe1.Write(rUst2+3 , sol, 10, sag - sol,UrtTarih )
	End if

	sol = solMargin + 1
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y2
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"PART (P)")
	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",48)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		'sKod = replace(trim(CHStokKodu)," ","-") '18.03.2015 Ford Þikayeti üzerine kaldýrýldý
		sKod=CHStokKodu
		BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(sKod)
	
		res = pe1.Write(rUst - 2, sol1 + 10,25,sag - sol1 - 10,sKod)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+16,sol1,10,BarkodGen,"CODE128","P" & sKod & "","")
	End if


	sol = SolMargin
	sag = SagMargin
	rUst = Y3 + 1
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"STR LOC 1")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",28)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+4, sol + 2,28,sag - sol, "AAAAA")


	IrsSeriNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_SERI", 0)
	IrsSiraNo = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK60E", STOK60E.EVRAKNO, "IRS_NO", 0)

	IrsaliyeNo = trim(IrsSeriNo) & "-" & trim(IrsSiraNo)

	rUst = Y3 + 1
	sol1 = Sol + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,6,sag - sol - 2.5,"DELIVERY DOC/ASN NUMBER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",32)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst+4, sol ,16,50,IrsaliyeNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+9, sol + 51, 5, BarkodGen-20, "CODE128","N" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "","")


	sol = SolMargin
	sag = D4
	rUst = Y4

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)

	if trim(StokKodu) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",14)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1, sol + 1,10,sag - sol - 1, StokKodu)
		ParcaAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,"")
		res = pe1.Write(rUst + 7, sol + 1,10,sag - sol - 1, ParcaAdi)

	SeriNo = UreticiKodu & EtiketNo
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(SeriNo)
